title: Assistant Property Manager (Fred B. Rooney Building)
description:
WinnCompanies is seeking for an Assistant Property Manager to join our team at Fred B. Rooney Building, a 150-unit affordable housing and commercial community located in Bethlehem, PA.

In this position, you will support the Property Manager in managing all aspects of the community, including leasing, accounts receivable, accounts payable, service requests, and customer service.

The ideal candidate will adhere to the following schedule: Monday through Saturday, from 8:30AM to 5:00PM, with occasional weekends required during the lease-up period.


Responsibilities
  • Monitor collections, post rent payments, enforce the collection policy and initiate legal action when required.
  • Facilitate all aspects of apartment leasing: touring with prospective residents, processing applications, recertifications and negotiating lease renewals.
  • Provide exceptional customer service, respond timely to resident issues and complaints, and promote positive resident relations.
  • Assist in all facets of physical and financial Management as needed and assigned.
  • Act as Property Manager in absence of the Manager for specified amounts of time.
  • Prepare financial reports for the Property Manager as well as resident correspondence, and recertification notices.
  • Monitor the flow of accounts payable from issuing purchase orders to processing invoices.
Requirements
  • High School diploma or GED equivalent.
  • Minimum of 1 year of relevant work experience in property management or leasing.
  • Less than 1 year of supervisory experience.
  • Prior experience with tax credit programs.
  • Experience with various computer systems, such as Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent customer service skills.
  • Superb attention to detail.
  • Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced office environment.
  • Ability to work with a diverse group of people and personalities.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Associate's degree.

Our Benefits:

Regular full-time US employees are eligible to participate in the following benefits:

- Generous time off policies (including 11 paid holidays (12 for MA employees); Generous Accrued Time Off increasing with years of service; Generous paid sick time; Annual day of service; Floating Holiday)

- 401(k) plan options with a company match

- Various Comprehensive Medical, Dental, & Vision plan options

- Flexible Spending Account, Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account options with HSA annual employer contribution

- Long Term Disability and voluntary Short Term Disability; Basic Term Life Insurance and AD&D; optional supplemental life insurance

- Health Expense Reimbursement program (including gym memberships, equipment, and subscriptions)

- Tuition Reimbursement program and continuous training and development opportunities

- Wellbeing program (group challenges, seminars, opportunities to earn points to reduce medical premiums), Employee Assistance Program, & Commuter and Parking Reimbursement options

- Employee Corporate Discount Programs (Verizon Wireless, Home Depot Pro, Staples, and more!)

- Flexible and/or Hybrid schedules are available for certain roles

- Employee Relief Program supporting employees with unexpected hardships that place undue financial stress on them and their families

- To learn more, visit winnbenefits.com

Why WinnCompanies?

A job you can be proud of : WinnCompanies is a nationally recognized leader in apartment community management and development. Our team members are committed to helping people in the communities we serve and making a positive difference in their lives.

A job that challenges you : Our employees are responsible for our growth and success, and we challenge our team members to always be their best in our fast-paced, dynamic and rewarding workplace.

A job you can learn from : We offer multi-faceted leadership and learning opportunities to support our team members’ career growth and professional development.

A team that cares : We value teamwork, innovation, diversity and mutual respect. Through our recognition and rewards programs, we’re committed to celebrating and uplifting our team members.

About Us:

WinnCompanies is a mission-driven, national business focused on building and operating top quality affordable housing communities for individuals and families of all incomes, including members of the U.S. Armed Forces and their families. Our people are the source of our success – 4,300+ team members working together to create the best possible living communities in 27 states, Washington, D.C., and Puerto Rico.

Whether your skills are in operations, maintenance, leasing, compliance, marketing, IT, HR, accounting or finance, there’s a role for you at WinnCompanies. Your passion for excellence can help us make a positive impact in the lives of real people every day.

title: [A] Growth Strategist
description:
Growth Strategist
Latin America (remote)

Who You Are:
You're a strategic operator with deep B2B marketing experience who thrives on ownership, client success, and data-driven impact. You have strong client presence, love building systems that scale, and can juggle multiple fast-moving projects with confidence. You're not just checking boxes, you're steering the RevOps Shop!

The Opportunity:
You'll serve as the lead account manager and RevOps expert for a portfolio of B2B clients. You'll own campaign strategy, marketing execution, and CRM operations while managing internal team workflows. In this role, success means building long-term client trust, launching high-performing campaigns, and driving measurable revenue outcomes. Expect to lead monthly business reviews, run point on HubSpot projects, and influence strategy from day one.

Who We Are:
RevOps Shop is a HubSpot-based RevOps and demand generation consultancy for B2B companies. We partner with SaaS startups, manufacturers, and global services firms to drive growth across the funnel. Our services span visitor identification, email engines, SEO, content, CRM optimization, and outbound automation. We act as a fractional RevOps and marketing team, embedding deeply with our clients.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead strategic client relationships and serve as their main advisor
  • Build and execute multi-channel campaigns (email, LinkedIn, paid)
  • Manage CRM workflows, lifecycle stages, and marketing automation in HubSpot and Salesforce
  • Drive data enrichment, segmentation, and reporting projects
  • Present monthly reviews with insights, blockers, and next steps
  • Coordinate internal teams across content, design, and operations
  • Maintain organized systems in ClickUp, HubSpot, and shared docs

Must-haves in a Candidate:

  • 4+ years in B2B account management, RevOps, or demand gen roles
  • 1+ year working in a B2B agency, in a Demand Gen or RevOps role
  • 2+ years of B2B client facing experience
  • Strong expertise in HubSpot (Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, CRM admin)
  • Confident client communicator with executive presence (C1+ English)
  • Strategic thinker with a knack for campaign planning and optimization
  • Proficient with marketing data, reporting, and dashboards
  • Comfortable in EST hours and based in Latin America

Nice to Have in a Candidate:

  • Experience with Clay, GPT, Zapier, Make
  • Familiarity with SaaS, manufacturing, or consulting

Details:

  • Full-time, remote from Latin America
  • Competitive USD salary + bonuses
  • Work aligned to EST time zone
  • Opportunity to grow into strategic leadership as we scale

Company Overview RevOps Shop is a HubSpot-based RevOps and demand generation consultancy for B2B companies. Our clients range from SaaS startups to global services firms. We deliver visitor ID, LinkedIn automation, enrichment, CRM admin, and full-funnel strategy.

description:

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Distribution Manager - Centro Oeste (Brasília) role at Swiss Re

Você é apaixonado pelo setor de seguros e gostaria de atuar ao lado de gestores comerciais altamente motivados? Tem interesse em trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, com conexões diretas com corretores, clientes e instituições bancárias? Se sim, essa oportunidade é para você!
Sobre a Vaga

  • Prospectar e desenvolver negócios na região Centro-Oeste, especialmente em Brasília, com foco em soluções para Riscos Corporativos (Garantia, Property, Engenharia, Responsabilidade Civil, Transporte e Agro).
  • Gerenciar o relacionamento com as agências da Bradesco Seguros e corretores de seguros da região.
  • Representar a Swiss Re Corporate Solutions em eventos, conferências e reuniões com clientes e corretores de alto nível.
  • Participar de projetos estratégicos como planos de negócios, expansão regional e desenvolvimento/gestão de canais de vendas e soluções para renovações.
  • Atuar em conjunto com áreas internas multifuncionais no desenvolvimento dos negócios.
  • Analisar e reportar tendências de mercado, além de contribuir com estratégias comerciais.
  • Interagir com diversas partes interessadas: Internamente: Gestores de linhas de negócio, Business Services, TI e áreas de suporte como Jurídico, Contabilidade e Fiscal. Externamente: Canais de distribuição, agências parceiras da Swiss Re CorSo e clientes corporativos.
Sobre o Time
Estamos vivenciando um momento de forte crescimento. Você fará parte do time comercial, atuando em parceria com as agências do nosso sócio JV. Nossa equipe é composta por Gerentes Sêniores de Distribuição altamente motivados, espalhados por todo o Brasil — e você será parte desse time.
Sobre Você
  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração, Economia, Agronomia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência no setor (Seguradoras, Corretoras de Seguros ou Bancos).
  • Rede de contatos sólida e ativa no mercado de seguros da região Centro-Oeste — esse ponto é essencial.
  • Perfil colaborativo, com forte orientação comercial e foco em resultados.
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma independente, com espírito empreendedor.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e organização.
  • Conhecimento em estatística e ferramentas como Excel e PowerPoint será considerado um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento em Inglês é um diferencial
  • Residir em Brasília ou região.
Sobre a Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
A Swiss Re é uma das principais provedoras globais de resseguros, seguros e outras formas de transferência de risco baseada em seguros. Antecipamos e gerenciamos riscos que vão desde catástrofes naturais e mudanças climáticas até crimes cibernéticos.
A Swiss Re Corporate Solutions é a unidade de seguros corporativos do Grupo Swiss Re. Oferecemos soluções inovadoras de seguro para grandes e médias corporações multinacionais, a partir de aproximadamente 50 localidades ao redor do mundo. Ajudamos nossos clientes a mitigar sua exposição ao risco, enquanto nosso serviço de sinistros — reconhecido como um dos melhores do setor — oferece ainda mais tranquilidade.
Nosso sucesso depende da nossa capacidade de construir uma cultura inclusiva, que incentive novas perspectivas e o pensamento inovador. A Swiss Re Corporate Solutions valoriza um ambiente de trabalho onde todos têm igualdade de oportunidades para crescer e se desenvolver profissionalmente, independentemente de idade, gênero, raça, etnia, identidade e/ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, habilidades físicas ou mentais, forma de pensar ou qualquer outra característica.
Em nosso ambiente flexível e inclusivo, todos podem ser autênticos, trazendo consigo sua paixão pela sustentabilidade.
Se você é um(a) profissional experiente retornando ao mercado de trabalho após uma pausa na carreira, incentivamos que se candidate às vagas em aberto compatíveis com suas habilidades e experiência.
Todas as nossas vagas são afirmativas para pessoas com deficiência.

description:
Company Overview

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Diversity & Inclusion

description:
Creative Strategist/Writer - PrestonReacts

WHO WE ARE

TBNR (T he B est N ever R est ) is a top YouTube Production Company that manages the massive YouTube channels and digital media brands of Preston , Brianna Arsement and more! Our YouTube channels have upwards of 60 million subscribers and 18 billion lifetime views. To work at TBNR Productions you must have a passion for YouTube with a drive to continuously grow and deliver the latest and greatest content!

Part investigative researcher, part creative writer, and 100% YouTube consumer, the Content Writer will be responsible for the ideation, research, and execution of highly engaging Reaction compilations. They will also write light hearted and funny outlines for talent to follow in each episode for our PrestonReacts YouTube channel.

JOB DESCRIPTION

We’re seeking someone who’s overly passionate about digital content and creators on YouTube, Tiktok, and Instagram Reels. The ideal candidate is genuinely excited to keep up with the latest multi-platform trends and is looking for an opportunity to make a name for themselves in the YouTube community.

Part investigative researcher, part creative writer, and 100% YouTube consumer, the Content Writer will be responsible for the ideation, research, and execution of highly engaging Reaction compilations. They will also write light hearted and funny outlines for talent to follow in each episode.

The ideal candidate is a YouTube junkie who understands how to make relevant content for the current generation of viewer, loves comedy, and wants to help guide the creative ship for one of the leading Content Production companies in the creator game!

WHO YOU ARE

  • YouTube obsessed and likes to have fun and be weird
  • A solutions oriented problem solver who isn't afraid of radical candor
  • A continued learner and seeker of further education to pursue growth
  • An excellent collaborator who fuels excitement
  • Someone who isn’t afraid to ask questions and spark change within themself and the Company
  • Someone with a positive disposition who learns from failure and recognizes wins

YOUR DIRECT RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Identify relevant compilation topics that will drive high engagement
  • Research and write outline and scripts
  • Craft compelling narratives that elevate the viewing experience and keep audiences engaged
  • Take feedback and edits gracefully and independently revise content to meet brand needs
  • Assist in putting together and maintaining our content strategy
  • Assist with production of shoots to ensure the creative vision comes to life
  • Help review and approve various assets including graphics and thumbnails
  • Quality control of final exports
  • Conduct content safety checks
  • Use YouTube Analytics to understand why things succeed or fail and make adjustments as needed

REQUIREMENTS

  • 2 years of experience with creative writing within the digital media space
  • Stellar writing skills, with a funny, sarcastic, clever voice that will easily adapt itself to the TBNR brand
  • Strong initiative and the ability for creative thinking as it relates to Pop Culture and content production
  • Ability to deliver content on tight deadlines
  • Experience using Google Suite, Monday.com (or other project management tools), and Slack preferred
  • On top of content being produced by competitors and like-minded brands
  • Deep understanding of YouTube backend
  • Must be organized and detail oriented

TBNR’s targeted total compensation rate for a full-time Creative Writer based in Dallas, Texas is between $50,000 and $60,000, which depends on experience, expertise, internal equity within the organization, location, and alignment with market data. Do you believe your skills are trailblazing and merit higher compensation? Still apply! If we agree, we’re willing to negotiate. In addition to compensation, below you’ll find a few of our fire perks:

FIRE PERKS (full time employees only)

  • 100% Company paid Medical Insurance
  • Company sponsored Dental and Vision Insurance
  • 401K with a 3% non-elective contribution from TBNR LLC that fully vests immediately
  • Flexible time off with 8 Company paid holidays

TBNR LLC is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment.

title: Supervisor(a) de Produção
description:
The Business Unit Leader leads their team towards success in creating sustainable people, profit, and planet value, by adopting the following roles:

1. Member of the Operations team

The Business Unit Leader aspires to drive the performance of the Shop first, even before their own Business Unit. They are actively involved in:

  1. Sharing best practices between Business Units and contributing to Plant performance in a collaborative manner, maintaining a "ONE MANUFACTURING TEAM" mindset.
  2. Detecting and developing talents to grow their careers in the Shop, exporting talent to support business needs.
  3. Supporting Shop decisions even under uncertainty and unfavorable circumstances.
  4. Improving Business Unit performance through coaching and feedback.
  5. Providing input on support team members' performance and development recommendations.

2. People developer

The Business Unit Leader is passionate about developing people, viewing their plant as a platform for recruitment, training, and professional growth. They are expected to:

  1. Promote a lifelong learning mindset by evaluating competencies and identifying development opportunities.
  2. Ensure development through Spoke training and social promotion projects.
  3. Utilize accessible career paths for all employees.
  4. Build and believe in diverse teams.
  5. Support competency development via mentoring and coaching.

3. Representative/Role model of Company values, purpose & strategy

The Business Unit Leader embodies the group's values and represents the Plant to employees by:

  1. Living out values and inspiring through behavior.
  2. Motivating teams using Michelin purpose & Dream.
  3. Ensuring understanding of the Plant strategy and individual roles in collective success.
  4. Aligning the shop vision and engaging teams to realize it.
  5. Addressing employee issues timely and ensuring accurate attendance records.
  6. Developing Safety as a core value, ensuring responsibility for safety among employees.

4. Customer & business partner

The Business Unit Leader understands customer needs and guides teams to be customer-centric. They are expected to:

  1. Understand customer requirements and their role in meeting expectations.
  2. Focus on all aspects of economic value creation.
  3. Support business through collaboration on industrialization, digitalization, and industry transformations.

5. Environment promoter

The Business Unit Leader promotes sustainability and environmental impact reduction by:

  1. Fostering a culture valuing sustainability and environment.
  2. Implementing strategies for environmental impact and biodiversity.

CARE AREA of EXCELLENCE

6. ICARE & Empowerment role model

Leading with the ICARE leadership model, inspiring and coaching teams to progress by:

  1. Inspiring passion for ICARE at all levels.
  2. Creating inclusive, safe, collaborative, and intelligent team environments.
  3. Fostering empowerment and engagement in plant evolution and transformation.

7. Operational Excellence Leader

Developing operational excellence by ensuring:

  1. Activities apply MMW practices, creating sustainable foundations for performance.
  2. Continuous progress through variation and non-value tasks reduction.
  3. Achievement of SMQDC performance levels and standards compliance.
  4. Team empowerment, increased autonomy, and responsibility.
  5. Effective problem-solving to eliminate root causes.

TECH AREA of EXCELLENCE

8. Digital and Innovation contributor

Driving innovation, engineering, and technology transformation by:

  1. Encouraging digital application use and data-driven approaches.
  2. Building foundations for transformation (data quality, skills, organization, roadmap).
  3. Supporting projects that develop capabilities aligned with Michelin strategy, promoting digital best practices.

Job Description
O Hub Digital faz parte da nossa área de Estratégia e Tecnologia, tendo papel de destaque na nossa transformação em uma empresa media tech e D2C. Job Description
O Hub Digital faz parte da nossa área de Estratégia e Tecnologia, tendo papel de destaque na nossa transformação em uma empresa media tech e D2C. Aqui cuidamos da gestão de dados e do desenvolvimento dos nossos produtos digitais como Globoplay, Globo.com, família G (G1, Ge, Gshow) e Cartola, visando a melhor experiência de consumo, interação e relacionamento com os nossos usuários.
Sobre a área
O time de Digital Analytics faz parte da estrutura de Data&AI e atua como um pilar estratégico para a avaliação da performance dos produtos digitais da Globo, como Globoplay, Cartola, GE, G1, entre outros. Nosso trabalho possibilita o entendimento do comportamento dos usuários e o impacto das iniciativas de negócio, fornecendo insumos valiosos para tomada de decisão e avaliação da efetividade das estratégias da empresa. Somos responsáveis por garantir a qualidade, governança e acessibilidade dos dados digitais, assegurando que a coleta esteja bem estruturada, confiável e alinhada aos objetivos de negócio.
Diversidade:
Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.
Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido (RJ, SP ou POA/RS)
Responsibilities and assignments
Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Apoiar a definição e a manutenção do framework de eventos (Ex: GA4, GTM, Amplitude), promovendo reuso e padronização na coleta de dados entre produtos e squads;
  • Garantir a governança da implementação de eventos, taxonomias, documentação e versionamento;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com stakeholders das áreas de produto, marketing, tecnologia e dados, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em estratégias de mensuração consistentes;
  • Atuar como referência técnica e promovendo padronização entre os times de produto;
  • Apoiar a integração de ferramentas de mensuração com plataformas de dados e marketing, promovendo interoperabilidade e consistência nas entregas;
  • Conduzir análises exploratórias e recorrentes com foco em comportamento do usuário, eficiência de funcionalidades e identificação de oportunidades;
  • Fomentar a cultura orientada a dados, promovendo boas práticas, capacitação técnica e troca de conhecimento entre os profissionais alocados em diferentes frentes.

Requirements And Qualifications
Do que você precisa:
  • Experiência sólida com ferramentas de mensuração digital, como Google Analytics 4 e Google Tag Manager;
  • Vivência na implementação e manutenção de estruturas de eventos e tags em ambientes com múltiplos produtos ou squads;
  • Domínio de SQL e experiência com análise de grandes volumes de dados em BigQuery ou tecnologias similares;
  • Conhecimento em processos de governança e documentação de dados (eventos, taxonomia, tracking plan);
  • Perfil colaborativo, com capacidade de atuar como referência técnica e fomentar boas práticas entre diferentes times;
  • Organização e disciplina para lidar com múltiplas iniciativas simultaneamente, mantendo visibilidade e consistência nas entregas.

Conhecimentos que te destacam:
  • Experiência sólida com ferramentas de mensuração digital - Amplitude;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados como Looker, Looker Studio (Data Studio) ou similares;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de dados, pipelines e integrações com plataformas de marketing;
  • Noções de JavaScript, debugging de eventos e ferramentas de inspeção (DevTools, Tag Assistant);
  • Experiência em atuação em estruturas de plataforma ou áreas de competência (chapter, center of excellence);
  • Vivência com governança de eventos, taxonomias e documentação técnica em escala;
  • Experiência com criação de frameworks reutilizáveis de coleta e análise de dados.

At Bunge, people don’t just come here to work, they come here to grow – solving challenges that directly impact the world with a diverse and talented team working to make us the most innovative and dynamic company in our industry.Bunge offers a strong compensation and benefits package and most importantly, in all we do we live our values:

Act as One Team by fostering inclusion, collaboration, and respect
Drive for Excellence by being agile, innovative and efficient
Do What's Right by acting safely, ethically, and sustainably

Overview


The Security Analyst I serves as Tier 1-2 Analyst member of the Bunge Global SOC and all operational activities that serve to protect the confidentiality, integrity and security management of business and employee information and systems in compliance with organization policies and standards. He/she will focus on structured tasks associated with proactive response, initial identification and remediation of suspicious network and host based activity. The successful candidate will have significant and demonstrated skills in the areas of: TCP/IP protocols; malware and virus behavior. The candidate should display strong technical depth that spans PC and server software, application and custom code. A solid technical background in computer vulnerabilities, attack vectors and exploits is required.

Essential Functions


Perform as part of the CTDO group, initial analysis, triage and response tasks of cyber events with the security team to operate a global SOC for Bunge to safeguard the company's assets, intellectual property and information systems.
Conduct Tier 1 SOC activities to collect, store, and correlate, analyze, identify and respond to security data derived from sensors.
Implement, configure, and optimize the detection and reporting capabilities of company’s global security tool suite.
Collect and analyze intrusion artifacts (e.g., event logs, source code, malware) and use discovered data to support incident response actions.
Conduct rapid incident response activities and cyber event investigations.
Conduct a level of critical thinking as it relates to root cause analysis of actual or suspected security incidents recommended corrective actions.
Provide and or contribute to the development of ad-hoc information security reports to be shared with the Information Security Working Group and other executive leadership, as required

Qualifications


Preferred candidate has 1-4+ years’ experience in the Information Technology field
Minimum of 2+ years of direct experience in Cyber Security, SOC operations, Incident Response, and Security tool integration & operations is required.
1+ years direct experience with Splunk, Fidelis, Falcon Host, Firewall and IDS/IPS technologies preferred.
1-2+ year in any position: system administrator, application developer, database administrator, LAN administrator.
Associate or Bachelor’s degree of Science in computer science, information systems, engineering, or programming
Industry recognized certifications such as, GSEC, GCIA, CEH. CISCO a plus
Intermediate scripting knowledge in Perl, PHP, ASP or Java with recent and basic programming experience as a plus
Minimum of 2 years of experience in compliance-oriented industry is preferred.
Advanced understanding and demonstrated technical skils and abilities in the technical information security operations domain
Ability to conduct analysis of multiple data sources and provide assessment on the relationship between threats, vulnerability and information value in the context of risk management for company.
Bi-lingual/Multi-lingual candidates preferred: English Advanced Spanish (Plus).
Solid understanding of the concept of risk-based decision-making (i.e. risk analysis, mitigation, resolution)
Ability to perform high-quality work, work with minimum supervision and deliver results in timely manner.
Must be able to communicate effectively regarding security, privacy, risk, and compliance to senior business leaders and fellow team members.
Able to draw upon proven experience to rapidly assimilate, understand, evaluate and recommend response actions to a variety of cyber events. He/she must be able to work with others in formal and ad-hoc team environments.
Demonstrated ability to configure, maintain and use core tools SPLUNK, Carbon Black or Fidelis.
This individual will have the proven ability to conduct event analysis and correlation; establish facts and deliver conclusions/recommendation under extremely short timelines.
Improve Bunge's outcomes by making data-driven decisions, keeping the customer at the forefront of all they do, and proactively gaining insight into the global strategy.
Collaborate, effectively communicate with others and take initiative to continually develop themselves.
Pursue opportunities to solve problems and take action while maintaining the ability to manage work, even in times of challenge or change.

Bunge (NYSE: BG) is a world leader in sourcing, processing and supplying oilseed and grain products and ingredients. Founded in 1818, Bunge’s expansive network feeds and fuels a growing world, creating sustainable products and opportunities for more than 70,000 farmers and the consumers they serve across the globe. The company is headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri and has 25,000 employees worldwide who stand behind more than 350 port terminals, oilseed processing plants, grain facilities, and food and ingredient production and packaging facilities around the world.

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Staff Product Designer para liderar a visão e a execução da nossa experiência de usuário para o app da Alice, olhando funcionalidades críticas como o atendimento médico digital. Você irá colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares — produto, engenharia, time de saúde, entre outros, para criar soluções encantadoras que ajudem a tornar as pessoas mais saudáveis. Nesta função, você terá a oportunidade de impulsionar e influenciar a estratégia de produto e design, impactando positivamente a vida de milhares de pessoas.

Somos um time enxuto com alta densidade de talentos, onde cada um tem um papel relevante e um impacto enorme. Evitamos burocracia e lentidão na tomada de decisões — tornar o mundo mais saudável exige velocidade, qualidade e desejo de mudança, de criar algo original.

A pessoa candidata ideal é alguém capaz de analisar problemas complexos, multifacetados, e que consiga criar soluções inovadoras, com uma arquitetura de experiência e design visual elegantes, úteis e funcionais. Valorizamos o desejo de promover mudança com senso de urgência, conciliando qualidade com velocidade, equilibrando visão com experimentação. Um dia típico se parece com você discutindo o roadmap e a estratégia de produto com PMs, olhando métricas de experiência, criando hipóteses de soluções com protótipos e participando de design reviews e critiques com mais designers, ajudando a elevar a prática de disciplina como um todo dentro da Alice.

Responsabilidades

Liderar o design de ponta a ponta para as principais funcionalidades do app Alice, defendendo experiências centradas no usuário, desde o conceito inicial até o lançamento e demais evolução.

Definir e comunicar a visão de experiência, alinhada à estratégia de produto, garantindo um design consistente e envolvente que resolva dores reais das pessoas usuárias.

Colaborar ativamente com equipes de Produto, Engenharia e Pesquisa para definir metas, priorizar funcionalidades e entregar soluções eficazes de alta qualidade.

Orientar e apoiar outras pessoas designers, compartilhando boas práticas, revisando trabalhos e ajudando a elevar o nível de qualidade da equipe.

Ajudar a definir sucesso do ponto de vista de experiência, definindo métricas e resultados desejados para as soluções.

Criar e refinar protótipos para validar ideias e coletar feedback, usando insights qualitativos e quantitativos para embasar decisões de experiência.

Contribuir, evoluir e manter nosso sistema de design, garantindo consistência visual e de interação que seja escalável e inclusiva.

Promover acessibilidade, usabilidade e inclusão em todo o processo de design, buscando constantemente experiências funcionais que atendam às necessidades de todas as audiências.

O que estamos procurando em pessoas interessadas

Histórico comprovado na liderança de projetos complexos, atuando tanto na estratégia(definição do que fazer) quanto na execução(como é a experiência), em ambientes multidisciplinares.

Profundo conhecimento em métodos de design centrado no usuário: pesquisa, wireframes, prototipagem, testes e iteração.

Experiência na criação de protótipos interativos para comunicar conceitos.

Habilidade de fazer gestão de stakeholders e trabalhar de forma autônoma.

Seja curioso em como AI pode ajudar a produzir um design melhor, mais rápido.

Mentalidade estratégica e habilidade para equilibrar visão de longo prazo com atenção a detalhes — capaz tanto de idealizar grandes cenários quanto de refinar elementos de UI.

Excepcionais habilidades de comunicação, com capacidade de influenciar e inspirar stakeholders de diferentes áreas.

Experiência com sistemas de design e na escalabilidade de padrões de design em múltiplas plataformas é um diferencial.

Paixão por liderar pelo exemplo, em vez de autoridade formal; você se realiza ao orientar e elevar outros(as) designers.

Modelo de trabalho

Para esta posição, sugerimos atuação híbrida, e é esperado que você vá pelo menos 2 vezes na semana ao nosso escritório. Nosso escritório é um lugar lindo e inspirador e fica na Av. Rebouças, 3535, em São Paulo, no bairro de Pinheiros. Se tiver curiosidade, só dar uma espiada aqui .

Na Alice, Design é uma disciplina unificada que inclui diferentes especialidades, como Product Design e Creative Design. Acreditamos que essa é a melhor forma de trazer consistência e manter uma visão integrada da nossa nossa experiência..


A especialidade de Product Design tem um papel fundamental na estratégia do negócio. Buscamos criar a melhor jornada possível com o produto e garantir o engajamento dos nossos membros. Dessa forma, quem usa Alice navega melhor pelo sistema de saúde, usa o serviço de forma eficiente e consequentemente se torna mais saudável. Isso reduz o nosso CAC (custo de aquisição) e o Care Cost (custo de servir saúde).

Oferecemos um pacote de compensation competitivo.

Para construir a melhor compensation, vamos equilibrar a sua experiência com o desafio da posição e time atual da Alice.

Nós estamos revolucionando o mercado de saúde no Brasil. Enquanto os comportamentos de consumo vêm evoluindo de forma acelerada, a experiência das pessoas com planos de saúde é a mesma de 20 anos atrás. Atritos, burocracia, demora para autorizar exames e para marcar consultas, reajustes exorbitantes. O plano é apenas um seguro financeiro reativo.

Somos um plano de saúde empresarial que sabe de saúde. Impulsionado por AI, garantimos que os nossos membros recebam o cuidado certo, no momento certo e no local certo. Proporcionamos uma jornada de saúde que é fácil de acessar, envolvente e extremamente confiável, realizando assim uma gestão proativa da saúde.

A Alice proporciona uma experiência de saúde integrada que já foi escolhida por mais de 8.000 empresas e é hoje o plano de mais de 45.000 pessoas. E esse número de empresas e membros não para de crescer, com nossa adição de membros tendo mais que triplicado quando comparamos de set-dez/23 para mai-set/24. Além disso, o nível de satisfação de nossos membros é 4,8/5 tanto com nosso atendimento 24 horas pelo app (Alice Agora) quanto com as consultas de nossos médicos especialistas. Isso é saúde como deve ser.

Junte-se a nós em nossa missão de tornar o mundo mais saudável. Você será parte fundamental na construção de um sistema de saúde mais sustentável que possa ser acessível para mais pessoas.

Na Alice, esperamos que você:

Trabalhe com paixão pelo propósito, fazendo da missão da Alice a sua missão;

Vá pra Arena e busque ser protagonista, desafiando o status-quo e tendo atitude e coragem de quem quer mudar;

Esteja subindo a barra e evoluindo todos os dias, para entregar o melhor que é possível sonhar;

Se importe com as pessoas, genuinamente, entendendo seus problemas com empatia e ajudando a resolvê-los;

Valorize trabalhar em um ambiente aberto, inclusivo e transparente, onde se possa ser quem verdadeiramente é;

Priorize a sua saúde e felicidade, afinal um time mais saudável gera mais valor.

Somos uma Healthtech fundada em 2019 com o propósito de tornar o mundo mais saudável; o que isso quer dizer, na prática, é que estamos trabalhando duro todos os dias para construir o que um sistema de saúde eficiente e humano deveriam ser.

Não é sobre usar tecnologia para um problema irrelevante ou pequeno, mas sim, repensar como a tecnologia deveria ser usada para gerar mais saúde e mais cuidado para as pessoas

Saúde está entre os maiores desafios da nossa geração: experiência subótima, baixos resultados na geração de saúde e custo exponencialmente crescente.

Alice é um novo capítulo em planos de saúde, implementando uma abordagem de cuidado coordenado e continuado, através de metodologias e tecnologias próprias, pensadas com o Membro no centro das decisões.

Para isso, buscamos um profissional que nos ajude, cada vez mais, a transformar vidas.

title: ERW Operations Manager Brazil
description:
Location

Goiás, Brazil — On-site near Rio Verde


Desired Knowledge And Experience

  • Degree in Engineering, Environmental Sciences, Agronomy, Logistics, or similar.
  • 5+ years in Brazilian agriculture, project management, or comparable field roles.
  • Proven record of industrial or academic collaboration in ERW-adjacent work.
  • Portuguese & English fluency; Spanish a plus.

About Us

ZeroEx is scaling permanent carbon removal through enhanced rock weathering (ERW) projects in Germany, Brazil, and the United States. We license cutting-edge measurement tech that verifies every tonne sequestered, opening up the ERW industry to mining and agribusinesses ready to add an additional business model or decarbonize their core business.
Culture is the shadow of people—self-guided missiles who run on trust, ownership, and speed. If you thrive in ambiguity, lead from any seat, and care deeply about climate impact, you’ll feel at home here.


Preferred Skills

  • Familiarity with carbon markets or MRV standards.
  • Hands-on GIS or farm management software experience.
  • Safety-first mindset and basic HSE certification.

About The Role

As ERW Operations Manager, you will steer day-to-day field execution in Goiás, aligning ZeroEx, Anglo American, and local stakeholders. You’ll own logistics, schedules, and rapid troubleshooting so our science and sampling run like clockwork from August onward.


What You'll Do

  • Team & Project coordination: work closely with field teams, Anglo American and ZeroEx to align objectives, coordinate tasks, track progress and solve operational challenges.
  • Project Set-up & Planning: Develop and maintain logistics plans, including logistics workflows, documentation and reports
  • Field visits: Participate in field visits to understand execution challenges and improve coordination between planning and on-the-ground realities
  • Process improvement: contribute to continuous improvement of operational processes by integrating feedback and lessons learned to implement best practices.

Additional Responsibilities Will Include

  • Producing concise status reports for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Maintaining farmer relationships to secure ongoing field access.
  • Supporting MRV researchers with sampling schedules and data integrity checks.

What Makes ZeroEx Special?

  • Mission now, not 2050 – Each tonne removed is verified, permanent, and immediate.
  • On-ground autonomy – You’ll make real-time calls that shape ZeroEx Brazil large-scale ERW deployment.
  • Global tight-knit team – Join scientists, founders, and operators who move fast and keep egos low.

description:
Sobre a Enter

A Enter foi fundada em 2023 com a missão de tornar o Brasil um protagonista em Inteligência Artificial. Unimos a expertise humana à eficiência da IA para ajudar grandes empresas da América Latina a otimizar processos críticos de alto volume e que exigem intenso trabalho manual. Atendemos clientes como Nubank, Latam, Banco BMG, iFood, SulAmérica, Banco Inter, Banco C6, entre outros.

A Vaga

A Enter está na interseção de três pilares fundamentais: grandes empresas, os escritórios de advocacia parceiros que conduzem as ações judiciais, e nossa plataforma de inteligência artificial, que impulsiona a eficiência e a precisão de todo o processo jurídico.

Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a qualidade e consistência das entregas dos escritórios parceiros, monitorando produtividade e assegurando que os processos estejam alinhados com os padrões da Enter.

O sucesso nessa função depende da sua capacidade de estruturar e manter um fluxo de trabalho eficiente e colaborativo, integrando nossa tecnologia ao dia a dia jurídico e assegurando que o valor gerado pela plataforma de IA chegue com excelência aos nossos clientes.

  • Aplicar rigor intelectual jurídico para avaliar nossa eficiência na elaboração das melhores defesas possíveis para nossos clientes.

  • Disposição para aprender, orientar, liderar e seguir conforme necessário.
  • Senso de urgência desproporcional, mantendo em mente a escalabilidade e a criação de processos replicáveis para garantir o sucesso a longo prazo.
  • Pessoas curiosas e que conseguem aprender coisas difíceis rapidamente.

Join to apply for the Product Manager, Dental role at Guardian Life

The Dental Product Manager plays a key role in developing, supporting, implementing and managing our dental insurance products to meet market needs, drive growth, and enhance member value. This role champions innovation by identifying and implementing forward-thinking solutions that differentiate our dental product portfolio while serving as the product subject matter expert, working cross-functionally with underwriting, sales, marketing, digital, legal, state filing, compliance, government relations and clinical teams to ensure product competitiveness, compliance and success. The areas of focus for this role includes, but is not limited to: business case development, supporting the development and implementation of the dental products and services, defining and overseeing the go-to-market activities, and supporting all current/inforce dental products, services and capabilities.
You Will:

  • Contribute to the development of a clear product vision and roadmap that is aligned with Guardian’s goals and objectives.
  • Assess key market factors, including competitive landscape, consumer and policyholder insights, and unmet customer needs to identify areas of opportunity for differentiated dental product or service enhancements to meet customer expectations and achieve growth for Guardian.
  • Support monitoring and participating in industry trade groups, meetings and other activities and sharing key learnings with all internal stakeholders.
  • Accountability for monitoring KPIs to ensure proper adoption and performance outcomes are achieved.
  • Work independently but also collaborates with the rest of the product managers and matrix partners to identify opportunities and deliver on shared initiatives.
  • Communicate effectively by articulating information in a manner that is easily understood, both internally and externally, across all levels of the organization and in large public forums.
  • Support negotiations with vendor partners, and influences stakeholders across multiple teams and departments.
  • Execute product management processes throughout the product lifecycle, including product development, roadmap planning, and launch activities.
  • Ensure that procedures and systems are updated as necessary and that changes are communicated to all interested parties.
  • Conduct regular market research and analysis to keep abreast of trends and adapt to the ever-changing market environment.
  • Deliver and present reports, product plans, and competitive analyses to internal stakeholders.
  • Support the development of compelling presentations and documentation. This includes representing Guardian in Thought Leadership webinars and speaking engagements, broker meetings and roadshows, industry associations, etc.
  • Responsible for developing and delivering product training and communication—both internally and externally—to ensure clear, consistent, and accurate messaging that supports the value proposition and effectively educates distribution partners and key stakeholders on product positioning.
You Have:
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in product management, preferably in claims, account management, implementation, and/or product management.
  • Direct dental group insurance experience.
  • The ability to contribute to the development of a clear product vision and translate that vision into actionable product roadmaps.Produces clear supporting documents in PowerPoint, Excel, etc.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to effectively handle multiple priorities.

  • Possesses excellent organizational skills.

  • Project management experience with a track record of delivering results on time and within budget.
  • Experience working within a matrixed environment and contributing to cross-functional teams.
  • Entrepreneurial – ability to work independently and under pressure; ability to bring clarity to ideas that may appear unclear or ambiguous in concept.
  • Exhibits financial acumen, analytical skills, ability to analyze and communicate financial information, and support business case development.
  • Knowledge of Agile and Lean product development methodologies.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in business, computer science, marketing science or related fields.

The Role:

We're looking for an experienced credit research analyst to join our Debtwire Credit Research Team. The team provides unique insights and valuation analysis on companies and their securities that are restructuring, in the process of a transforming event or raising capital. Key tasks will include reviewing financial statements and legal documents to produce detailed credit research on stressed, distressed, and restructuring companies. The analysis will be produced in reports produced for subscribers of Debtwire, an ION Analytics subsidiary.

You will have the option to work remotely, including a flexible contract and competitive rates.


Key Responsibilities:
  • Produce Credit Reports that provide financial and valuation analysis on high-yield, distressed and stressed companies.
  • Interact with subscribers electronically and personally to discuss credit and macro analysis.
  • Along with creating credit research, the candidate will assist in special reports and ad-hoc projects.
  • Interact with management and IR teams of companies covered. Attend conferences and company investor day as needed.
Required Skills, Experience, and Qualifications
  • The candidate should have 5+ years as either a credit or equity analyst.
  • Naturally curious and driven to figure out how to analyze complex situations and be tenacious in obtaining information.
  • Excellent understanding of financial statements: income statement, balance sheet and cash flows and the drive to thoroughly read the information supporting the financial statements.
  • A thorough understanding of debt and equity securities and the markets they trade in is required, including some knowledge of bankruptcy processes.
  • Valuation experience including waterfall, and DCF analysis is required.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of fixed income analytics (ie Z-spread, duration).
  • Fluency in Portuguese and/or Spanish (both strongly preferred).
  • Comprehensive knowledge of Excel and Word
  • Excellent writing skills, with the ability to build a thesis and reach a conclusion in a structured manner, are required.
  • Experience writing reports in English.
  • Ability to work in a team-based environment, with a sense of teamwork and cooperation
  • Ability to manage workflow under strict deadlines

About us

We’re a diverse group of visionary innovators who provide trading and workflow automation software, high-value analytics, and strategic consulting to corporations, central banks, financial institutions, and governments. Founded in 1999, we’ve achieved tremendous growth by bringing together some of the best and most successful financial technology companies in the world.

• Over 2,000 of the world’s leading corporations, including 50% of the Fortune 500 and 30% of the world’s central banks, trust ION solutions to manage their cash, in-house banking, commodity supply chain, trading and risk.

• Over 800 of the world’s leading banks and broker-dealers use our electronic trading platforms to operate the world’s financial market infrastructure.

ION is a rapidly expanding and dynamic group with 13,000 employees and offices in more than 40 cities around the globe. Our ever-expanding global footprint, cutting edge products, and over 40,000 customers worldwide provide an unparalleled career experience for those who share our vision.

ION is committed to maintaining a supportive and inclusive environment for people with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We respect the varied identities, abilities, cultures, and traditions of the individuals who comprise our organization and recognize the value that different backgrounds and points of view bring to our business.

ION adheres to an equal employment opportunity policy that prohibits discriminatory practices or harassment against applicants or employees based on any legally impermissible factor.

Description

The Senior Account Manager is responsible for delivering comprehensive management services to a portfolio of captive insurance companies. This role operates under general direction and focuses on financial statement preparation and review, regulatory compliance, and client relationship management. The position plays a key part in supporting strategic initiatives, ensuring adherence to accounting practices, and maintaining effective communication with clients, regulators, and service providers. Ideal candidates will have a strong background in accounting and captive insurance, excellent analytical and communication skills, and the ability to manage complex issues and client needs with professionalism.

Note: visa employment-based non-immigrant visa sponsorship and/or assistance is not offered for this specific job opportunity.

The Role

Ensures strong relationships with client, regulators, captive directors and key service providers.Primary focus on financial statement review and/or preparation. Works as part of the Client Service Team, as well as interacts with clients, prospects, regulators and external service providers.

Specific Responsibilities:

Insurance

  • Liaison with insurance broker and reinsurance brokers as required.
  • Assist with underwriting documentation and decisions in conjunction with the Client Service Team and the Practice Underwriting resources, as appropriate.
  • Monitoring of exposures and risk transfer pricing within assigned portfolio.
  • Obtain regulatory approval for changes to the business plan.
  • Obtain Board approval for underwriting decisions.

Finance/Regulatory

  • Monitoring of domicile solvency and capital requirements
  • Obtaining regulatory approval of changes to business plan
  • Obtaining board approval for underwriting decisions
  • Accounting for premium
  • Agree reserving methodology
  • Ensure the production of management financial statement accounts, statutory accounts and information, budgets, cash flow statements and supplementary information as required.
  • Assist with the adoption of appropriate accounting practices and ensure adherence thereto.
  • Manage or supervise cash requirements of the companies
  • Liaise with and monitor investment managers in respect of invested funds
  • Assist Client Service Team with co-ordination of board meetings
  • Ensure timely production and accuracy of board papers.
  • Ensure timely production of minutes and review prior to distribution.
  • Action matters arising from client meetings
  • Ensure relevant company secretarial functions are performed in a timely manner.
  • Ensure compliance with Corporate Governance.

Management

  • To assist in providing input on strategic and operational issues. Assume responsibility for a specific area of company strategy.
  • To assist in implement policies adopted by Practice
  • Contact is maintained with all client directors and that they are advised of any developments.
  • Keep Practice leadership apprised of client developments.
  • Entertain clients & prospects as required.
  • Support Senior Management in performing board insight, perspective & thought leadership as required
  • Understands importance of Internal Control procedures and the WTW code of Conduct and works to be seen as a role model in the office.

Qualifications

Requirements

  • 4-year degree in Accounting, Finance or equivalent work experience, or related area or CPA qualification
  • Advanced Computer Skills
  • In depth knowledge and experience of captive insurance and insurance industry in the following areas:(1) accounting for captives (2) insurance products, and (3) problem resolution
  • Willis Towers Watson knowledge (platforms, structure, etc.)
  • Ability to monitor quality control
  • Client relationship skills
  • Project Management skills
  • Board meeting presentation skills
  • Working toward Leadership and People Management skills
  • Compliance
  • Can solve complex issues and will raise highly complex issues to higher level
  • Ability to influence and negotiate
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

This position will remain posted for a minimum of three business days from the date posted or until sufficient/appropriate candidate slate has been identified.
Compensation and Benefits

Base salary range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, qualifications/experience, performance in the role and potential for revenue generation (Producer roles only).

Compensation

The base salary compensation range being offered for this role is $80,000.00-$130,000.00 USDannually.

This role is also eligible for an annual short-term incentive bonus.
Company Benefits

WTW provides a competitive benefit package which includes the following (eligibility requirements apply):

  • Health and Welfare Benefits: Medical (including prescription coverage), Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Commuter Account, Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Group Accident, Group Critical Illness, Life Insurance, AD&D, Group Legal, Identify Theft Protection, Wellbeing Program and Work/Life Resources (including Employee Assistance Program)

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Team Lead role at Street Diligence, Inc.

Street Diligence is a high-growth FinTech start-up with an innovative product offering and ambitious expansion plans. Our clients include leading financial institutions that use our platform to analyze and negotiate advantageous terms in legal and financial contracts. We break down key terms, identify what’s “market” and “off-market” and flags risks embedded in contract terms. Our platform also provides unique visuals, benchmarking and comparison to place negotiations and contracts in context. Founded in 2012, Street Diligence is headquartered in New York.
About The Role
Street Diligence Inc. is seeking a dynamic Software Engineering Team Lead to drive the development of high-quality software solutions. This role is ideal for a seasoned engineer with hands-on experience in large web applications & moderate codebases. You should have a solid grasp of modern programming design patterns. You will lead a talented team of engineers, ensuring sprint assignments are efficiently executed while providing technical guidance and architectural vision. Your expertise in architecting scalable solutions will be key to our continued innovation and success.
What You'll Do
Technical Leadership & Mentoring

  • Team Guidance: Participate in providing technical guidance to software engineers, ensuring that sprint tasks are well-defined, prioritized, and completed on schedule.
  • Code Quality: Conduct regular code reviews and enforce best practices to maintain a robust, clean, and sustainable codebase.
  • Knowledge Sharing: Lead regular technical discussions and workshops to foster continuous learning and development among team members.
Architecture & Design
  • Solution Architecture: Help to design and architect scalable, high-performance solutions that meet both current and future business needs.
  • Design Patterns: Apply and promote proven programming design patterns and best practices across projects, ensuring consistency and maintainability in complex codebases.
Collaboration & Communication
  • Cross-functional Coordination: Work closely with UX/UI designers, QA teams, and other stakeholders to integrate feedback and align on project goals.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring transparency and shared understanding across the organization.
What You'll Bring To The Table
Education & Experience:
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in software development, with a proven track record in a leadership or team lead role.
Technical Skills:
  • Experience working with large or complex codebases and a deep understanding of programming design patterns.
  • Proven experience in architecting scalable software solutions.
  • Strong understanding of web application development and modern web design patterns.
  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, Ruby, C#, Java, JavaScript) and familiarity with full-stack development concepts.
  • Strong background in agile development methodologies and continuous integration practices.
Additional Skills:
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a passion for building innovative solutions.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively mentor and support team members.
  • A commitment to maintaining high standards of code quality, including unit testing and behavior-driven development practices.
This role is a unique opportunity to drive technical excellence, and to help contribute to the evolution of our software architecture. If you’re passionate about engineering leadership and ready to take on new challenges, we encourage you to apply.
We know that not everyone will meet all of the qualifications listed above. If your experience doesn't perfectly align, but you believe you'd be a strong fit for the team, we encourage you to apply. We’re eager to learn more about what you can offer!

Desenvolver comercialmente os clientes dos canais Indireto (Distribuidores e Atacados), g arantindo a execução da estratégia de nossas marcas, com muito foco externo em Sell out.

Suas responsabilidades

Com a inclusão no centro de tudo o que fazemos, trabalhando em conjunto com os nossos Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), apoiamos os nossos colaboradores em cada etapa da sua jornada profissional, ajudando-os a ter sucesso à sua maneira individual.

Sabemos que, nem sempre, se tem todos os requisitos pedidos para uma posição. We are looking for a Frontend Software Engineer (Vue/JS) to join our UX Engineering team at our Porto Alegre office. As part of the UX Engineering team, the successful candidate will be responsible for building and evolving our frontend applications that enable clients to configure and use our products.

  • Build and evolve out frontend applications;

What You’ll Bring
  • Experience with frontend (HTML, CSS, JS, TypeScript, Tailwind) and market frameworks (VueJs, Astro, React, Angular, etc);
  • Experience with REST and GQL APIs;
  • Experience with testing tools and layers (Jest, Cypress, PlayWright);
  • Experience with UNIX development environments (we use MacBooks at Azion);
  • Knowledge in state management (pinia, redux, or similar);
  • Knowledge in componentization and good practices for UI and UX;
  • Knowledge in HTTP requests (status codes, headers, etc);
  • Good code organization and knowledge of good practices;
  • Intermediate english (our code base is written in english).
Bonus Points
  • Familiarity with platforms for quickly prototing and deploying (Vercel, Supabase, Cloudflare, or more traditional services like AWS or GCP);
  • Knowledge in good project patterns;
  • Familiarity with storybook;
  • Knowledge in Edge Computing or CDNs;

FlexWork Model
We offer a FlexWork model that prioritizes acculturation and collaboration. For the first three months, you will work on-site in the local office, an essential step in building solid relationships and a genuine connection with our values and culture. We believe that this initial immersion not only strengthens the team, but also boosts creativity and innovation.

title: Drill & Blast Subject Matter Expert - Independent Consultant
description:
As an open pit mine drill and blast subject matter expert, you will work with colleagues at dss+ to improve safety in opening pit mining operations with a specific focus on drill and blast operations.

You’ll save lives, drive performance and improve the working lives of our clients’ employees.

As a freelance specialist in drill and blast operations, you will be expected to provide technical expertise as part of the dss+ team to the client and its employees, whilst supporting a larger transformation project.

Specifically, you will be providing technical advice on drill & blast processes, including:

  • Blast design

  • Explosive selection and handling

  • Drill rigs

  • Risk Assessment methodologies

The project is scheduled to start in September 2025, with onboarding and training taking place from mid-to-late August.


At dss+, we embrace and celebrate diversity. Above all, we are an inclusive culture in which everyone contributes and has the chance to develop their talents further.


As a technical expert with operational experience of risk and safety management in the field of Drill & Blast engineering in open pit mining you will have the following experience and expertise:

Blast Design Expertise:

  • Proficient in designing drill patterns, burden, spacing, subdrill , stemming, and initiation sequences.

  • Deep understanding of blast fragmentation modeling , throw control, and muck pile shaping for loading efficiency.

  • Knowledge of controlled blasting techniques (e.g., presplit, cushion blasting) near pit walls.

Explosives Selection & Handling:

  • Solid experience with ANFO, emulsions, boosters, detonators (Nonel, electronic), and primers .

  • Understanding of explosive energy characteristics and their impact on rock mass fragmentation and vibration.

Initiation Systems:

  • Familiarity with advanced electronic blasting systems , including timing control and vibration management.

  • Ability to evaluate the safety and performance implications of different initiation sequences .

Drill Rigs and Equipment:

  • Knowledge of drill rig capabilities, maintenance, bit selection , and their effect on hole deviation and blasting outcomes.

Risk Assessment Methodologies:

  • Application of Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA) , Bowtie , or Hazard Identification (HAZID) techniques.

  • Use of probabilistic or semi-quantitative risk models for evaluating likelihood and impact.

Monitoring and Control Techniques:

  • Interpretation of data from blast monitoring tools : seismographs, high-speed cameras, drone imagery.

  • Knowledge of post-blast audits , including fragmentation analysis (e.g., WipFrag), vibration data, and flyrock trajectory evaluation.

  • Familiarity with ground vibration and airblast prediction models and regulatory thresholds (e.g., NIOSH, ISEE, Brazilian standards).

Due to the multi-national make up of the teams you will be working with, you will need to be able to work in both English and Portuguese at a professional level.

Diversity and Inclusion

dss+ is committed to a diverse workforce and believes that this is essential to strengthening our company and driving sustainable growth. We are committed and driving accountability for growing DSS through diversity. Diversity is an indispensable part of our organization's culture. The goal of our commitment to inclusion, dignity, and equal opportunity has not only become a competitive advantage for us but has attracted highly capable and talented employees to DSS.

dss+ works with clients to save lives and create a sustainable future. To do so effectively, we live our core values that underpin our thinking, our goals and our actions, every step of the way. Coupled with our passion and expertise, the dss+ core values ensure we forge a path to success for our employees, stakeholders and clients — one that we can all be proud of. Respect for people

We treat our employees and all our partners with professionalism, dignity and respect, fostering an environment where people can contribute, innovate and excel.

Highest ethical behaviour

We conduct ourselves and our business affairs in accordance with the highest ethical standards, striving always to be a respected corporate citizen worldwide.

SEJA BEM-VINDO AO HOSPITAL ALEMÃO OSWALDO CRUZ

Nossa história é marcada por um legado de mais de 125 anos de excelência em saúde. Somos uma instituição de referência em medicina de alta complexidade, que busca o protagonismo no desenvolvimento da saúde por meio da melhor experiência e resultado aos pacientes, da pesquisa, educação e inovação e do nosso compromisso social. Temos a mais importante certificação da área da saúde: a Joint Commission International (JCI) – principal agência mundial de acreditação em saúde, o que assegura qualidade e segurança no atendimento.

Há mais de 15 anos, atuamos no Projetos de Apoio ao Desenvolvimento Institucional do Sistema Único de Saúde (Proadi-SUS), onde temos a oportunidade de contribuir com o fortalecimento de sistemas públicos de saúde em todo o Brasil.

Temos o propósito de servir à vida de todas as pessoas. E trabalhamos incessantemente para sermos a melhor escolha em cuidados de saúde, na percepção de nossos pacientes, médicos e de todo ecossistema de saúde em transformação.

Valorizamos as especificidades de cada ser humano. Começamos cuidando bem de quem cuida: dos nossos mais de 3.800 colaboradores. Somos comprometidos em assegurar que as políticas internas estejam alinhadas aos princípios de diversidade, equidade e inclusão para que haja um ambiente acolhedor e respeitoso a todos que fazem parte da organização. Buscamos por mais compromisso com a sociedade. Mais formas de compreender as pessoas. Mais segurança para quem atende ou é atendido. Mais acolhimento e humanização nas relações entre as pessoas.

Aqui no hospital, prezamos por candidatos que buscam evolução de carreira constante e proativa. Sabemos que esse tipo de profissional está sempre procurando novas formas de aprendizado, por isso fornecemos estímulos de crescimento para todo o nosso time. Além de aprender com profissionais que são referência no mercado de saúde, ofertamos iniciativas de desenvolvimento que possibilitam aos nossos profissionais progredirem em suas carreiras, juntamente com o progresso da nossa instituição. Temos programas consolidados para aprendizes, estagiários corporativos e de enfermagem, inclusão e formação de PCD, desenvolvimento de nossas lideranças, além de um portal moderno para treinamentos e ações educativas.

Hoje, o Hospital concretiza seu propósito de servir à vida por meio de atividades que abrangem todo o ciclo da saúde – promoção, assistência, diagnóstico, tratamento, reabilitação, educação, pesquisa, saúde integral e impacto na sociedade.

title: DevOps - especialista em GIT
description:
Somos uma empresa em expansão no mercado Tech. Buscamos evoluir, incluir, crescer, sonhar e aplaudir junto com as nossas pessoas. Queremos que você se sinta muito mais que número e resultados e, se quiser fazer parte de um time que tem como objetivo transformar as relações de carreira e vida pessoal, seu lugar é aqui.

Na Maitha, você terá a oportunidade de atuar alocado na maior empresa do mercado de crédito no Brasil, que busca soluções para melhorar a saúde financeira da população.

Vaga híbrida São Paulo ou Blumenau.

Responsabilidades:

As atividades estão voltadas para CI/CD e gerenciamento de GitLab on-premise, teria um papel multifacetado dentro da equipe de desenvolvimento e operações.

Desenvolvimento e Manutenção de Pipelines de CI/CD:

- Configuração de Pipelines: Criar e configurar pipelines de CI/CD para automatizar o processo de integração e entrega de software. Isso inclui a definição de jobs, estágios e gatilhos.

- Otimização de Pipelines: Melhorar e otimizar pipelines existentes para garantir eficiência e reduzir o tempo de execução.

- Resolução de Problemas: Diagnosticar e corrigir falhas em pipelines, garantindo que os processos de construção, teste e implantação sejam concluídos com sucesso.

Administração do GitLab On-Premise:

- Configuração Inicial: Configurar e manter a instalação do GitLab em servidores on-premise, incluindo a configuração de repositórios, permissões e gerenciamento de branches.

- Gerenciamento de Repositórios: Criar e gerenciar repositórios Git, incluindo a configuração de proteções e regras para branches.

- Segurança e Manutenção: Monitorar e aplicar atualizações de segurança e patches, além de realizar manutenção regular para garantir a estabilidade do sistema.

Automação de Processos:

- Desenvolvimento de Scripts: Criar e manter scripts em Python, Bash ou Ruby para automatizar tarefas rotineiras e processos operacionais.

Integração de Ferramentas: Integrar ferramentas e serviços com pipelines de CI/CD para melhorar a automação e a eficiência.

Gerenciamento de Containerização:

- Configuração de Containers: Configurar e gerenciar containers usando Docker, criando imagens e gerenciando o ciclo de vida dos containers.

- Orquestração com Kubernetes: Implantar e gerenciar aplicações em clusters Kubernetes, garantindo escalabilidade e resiliência.

Integração com CI/CD: Integrar Docker e Kubernetes com pipelines de CI/CD para automação de builds e deploys.

- Configuração de Monitoramento: Configurar e manter ferramentas de monitoramento como Prometheus, Grafana ou Datadog para acompanhar a saúde e o desempenho das aplicações e infraestrutura.

- Configuração de Logging: Configurar e manter ferramentas de logging como ELK Stack ou Datadog para coletar e analisar logs de aplicações e sistemas.

- Análise de Dados: Analisar métricas e logs para identificar e resolver problemas de performance e operação.

Controle de Versão:

- Gerenciamento de Branches: Configurar e gerenciar estratégias de branching e merging no Git para suportar o fluxo de trabalho de desenvolvimento.

- Revisões e Pull Requests: Facilitar e revisar pull requests, garantindo que o código seja revisado e integrado de acordo com as melhores práticas.

Colaboração e Suporte:

- Trabalho em Equipe: Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento e operações para garantir que os processos de CI/CD atendam às necessidades do projeto.

- Suporte Técnico: Fornecer suporte técnico para questões relacionadas a CI/CD, GitLab, Docker, Kubernetes e ferramentas de monitoramento/logging.

Requisitos essenciais:

Conhecimento em CI/CD:

- Experiência prática na implementação e manutenção de pipelines de CI/CD.

- Familiaridade com conceitos de integração contínua, entrega contínua e implantação contínua.

- Experiência com a configuração e administração do GitLab em ambientes on premise.

- Conhecimento sobre a criação e gerenciamento de repositórios, permissões e branches.

Linguagens de Programação para Scripts:

- Conhecimento em linguagens como Python, Bash ou Ruby para automação de processos.

Ferramentas de Containerização:

- Experiência com Docker e Kubernetes, especialmente em integração com pipelines de CI/CD.

- Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento (como Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog) e logging (como ELK Stack, Datadog).

Controle de Versão:

- Sólido entendimento do Git e suas melhores práticas.

Metodologias Ágeis:

- Experiência em trabalhar com Scrum ou Kanban e compreensão do ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento de software.

Requisitos desejáveis:

- Conhecimento na ferramenta ágil Jira

- Migração de ambiente Repository/CI/CD de Bitbucket para Gitlab

Competências comportamentais:

- Comunicação: Capacidade de se comunicar de forma clara e eficaz, tanto verbalmente quanto por escrito, com equipes técnicas e não técnicas.

- Colaboração: Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe, colaborando com desenvolvedores, testers e outras partes interessadas.

- Resolução de Problemas: Aptidão para identificar problemas rapidamente e desenvolver soluções eficazes.

- Adaptabilidade: Capacidade de se adaptar a novas tecnologias e mudanças de processo, mantendo-se atualizado com as tendências de CI/CD.

- Proatividade: Disposição para antecipar necessidades e buscar melhorias nos processos existentes.

- Organização: Habilidade para gerenciar múltiplas tarefas e prioridades, garantindo prazos e qualidade.

- Mentalidade de Aprendizado Contínuo: Interesse em desenvolver continuamente suas habilidades e conhecimentos na área.

- Inglês: Proficiência em inglês, tanto escrito quanto falado, para leitura de documentação técnica, comunicação com equipes internacionais e participação em conferências ou workshops.

Necessário disponibilidade para atuar no modelo hibrido em São Paulo SP.

title: ERW Scientist / Researcher Brazil
description:
Location

Goiás, Brazil — On-site near Rio Verde


Desired Knowledge And Experience

  • PhD in Geochemistry, Soil Science, Agronomy, Environmental Science, Geology, or related field.
  • Deep understanding of inorganic & organic soil carbon cycling and silicate dissolution kinetics.
  • Hands-on experience with soil/rock/water sampling and analysis.
  • Track record in designing and running field or mesocosm trials.
  • Portuguese & English fluency; Spanish a plus.
  • Willingness to travel across rural Goiás.

About Us

ZeroEx is scaling permanent carbon removal through enhanced rock weathering (ERW) projects in Germany, Brazil, and the United States. We license cutting-edge measurement tech that verifies every tonne sequestered, opening up the ERW industry to mining and agribusinesses ready to add an additional business model or decarbonize their core business.
Culture is the shadow of people—self-guided missiles who run on trust, ownership, and speed. If you thrive in ambiguity, lead from any seat, and care deeply about climate impact, you’ll feel at home here.


Preferred Skills

  • Geochemical modelling with PHREEQC or GWB.
  • Familiarity with carbon markets or MRV standards.
  • Strong scientific network in ERW-related disciplines.

About The Role

As our on-site ERW Scientist in Brazil, you’ll own all scientific work across current and future projects—translating global research plans into field and lab reality in Goiás. You’ll design trials, run sampling campaigns, and generate the data that underpins our MRV.


What You'll Do

  • Sampling & analysis coordination: plan, schedule, and execute soil, rock, water, and pore-water sampling across multiple sites.
  • Method development: design and refine protocols to measure silicate weathering rates and carbon fluxes.
  • Field trials: set up and oversee mesocosm and in-field experiments; iterate quickly to test new approaches.
  • Data interpretation: collaborate with ZeroEx scientists to analyse results and feed insights back into operations.
  • Networking: build relationships with Brazilian universities, labs, and regulators to accelerate ERW adoption.

Additional Responsibilities Will Include

  • Maintaining detailed SOPs and ensuring QA/QC on all samples.
  • Training field technicians on best-practice sampling methods.
  • Contributing to publications, grant proposals, and conference presentations.

What Makes ZeroEx Special?

  • Mission now, not 2050 – Each tonne removed is verified, permanent, and immediate.
  • On-ground autonomy – You’ll make real-time calls that shape ZeroEx Brazil’s scientific program.
  • Global tight-knit team – Join scientists, founders, and operators who move fast and keep egos low.

In addition, you will engage directly with stakeholders within the client organisation to interpret their requirements, provide immediate support and consulting, and leverage in-depth support from the core Sibylline team.
You will develop tailored intelligence reports with strategic insight on various geopolitical topics and collect intelligence information and track threats and geopolitical developments directly or indirectly affecting the client’s assets, people, and interests globally.   • Attend Studio Security and Security Operations team meetings to collect requirements and understand priorities
