title: Sales Development Representative, LATAM
description:
Feedzai is the world’s first RiskOps platform for financial risk management, and the market leader in safeguarding global commerce with today’s most advanced cloud-based risk management platform, powered by machine learning and artificial intelligence. Feedzai is securing the transition to a cashless world while enabling digital trust in every transaction and payment type. The world’s largest banks, processors, and retailers trust Feedzai to protect trillions of dollars and manage risk while improving the customer experience for everyday users, without compromising privacy. Feedzai is a Series D company and has raised $282M to date. With a valuation of +$1.5B, the company's technology protects 900 million people in 190 countries.

You:

As an Sales Development Representative at Feedzai, you play a key role in enabling the sales of our leading AI/Machine learning platform. You will closely work with Account Executives, other members of the sales team and other cross functional partners such as marketing and partnerships focussed on business development, to make sure we build the right quality and quantity of pipeline.

Your Day to Day:

GTM research, positioning & thought leadership

  • Research and analyze the market and target accounts in territory and enrich target account lists
  • Establish first contact with the stakeholders within target accounts (All levels including c-level executives)
  • Demonstrate the ability to talk about industry trends, discover client challenges and position how Feedzai’s go to market solutions can solve their needs
  • Demonstrate understanding of market segmentation and key personas to target and the key messaging to be delivered

Inbound and Outbound initiatives to generate pipeline:

  • Demonstrate ability to quickly qualify inbound leads by using methodologies such as CHAMP while focussing on being customer centric by applying value selling
  • Show ability to work alongside Marketing, Partners and Sales in order to generate qualified opportunities
  • Ability to work and nurture leads and convert them into qualified opportunities
  • Demonstrate ability to build outbound campaigns for targets accounts leveraging emails, account based marketing, calling, social selling and more
  • Demonstrate ability of a proper handover of qualified opportunities to the Account Executives
  • Ability to aggregate market information and provide feedback to the necessary stakeholders which allows for further GTM refinement
  • Be creative in finding new ways to refine our GTM and spotting new opportunities

Selling the dream

  • Ability to create a vision with a prospect
  • Build trust, credibility and rapport with prospect, leads, and opportunities it’s all about authentic human relationships
  • Ability to be honest and find value for our prospects by focusing on their challenges and needs and linking that to our value proposition
  • Giving convincing and inspiring presentations to top-level executives while applying consultative and value selling techniques

Forecasting & Reporting

  • Ability to be data driven and accurately forecast lead conversion
  • Ability to understand what is needed to proactively build the right pipeline in order to hit targets
  • Ability to provide insightful reporting to management and the region operated within

You Have & You Know-how:

  • Experience in selling enterprise technology in a fast-paced start-up or scale-up environment. (Fintech is a plus).
  • You have around 2-3 years proven experience as an Sales Development Representative in the LATAM region
  • You are fluent in English (Spanish is a plus) with excellent communication and presentation skills
  • You are a strong relationship builder, you are transparent & honest and understand a consultative and value sales approach
  • Hands-on and entrepreneurial mentality with a strong drive and eagerness to learn
  • You are organized, structured and analytical, you have a strong data driven and target focused approach.
  • An open minded person that enjoys giving remote presentations for clients & prospects in an engaging way.
  • Creative thinking: finding new routes to leads and opportunities - A well developed local network and work on expanding it
  • Key traits: Ambition, Integrity, Adaptability, Customer Centric, Proactive, Perseverance, and Entrepreneurial.

Your First 30-Days at Feedzai:

You will be immersed in our brand with training, connections, and one-on-one time with your manager. You may shadow your colleagues virtually or onsite at an office depending on where you work as you are supported through your Feedzai journey. In addition, you will have access to a ton of information to give you history, context, and all the knowledge you can handle about Feedzai and the team. Finally, you will start working on projects and collaborating on work currently being done. We can't wait to have you join the team!

title: Computer Technician, Sr. - McMurdo, Antarctica (Austral Summer 2025)
description:
Job Purpose

The Computer Technician Senior position provides PC support to users at USAP stations. This position is responsible for maintaining, implementing, configuring and repairing all computer systems and related peripheral systems and equipment. Installs and configures computer hardware and software. Provides direct user support for Tier 2 and Tier 3 work orders. Provides front-line support of grantee computer needs. This support includes general computer and application support, and customized activities such as computer to instrumentation interfacing. Guides and directs junior computer technicians in the accomplishment of mission and work tasks.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Perform troubleshooting and repairs on all computers, peripheral systems and equipment, according to current desktop standard configuration guidelines and documented procedures.
  • Perform daily review of assigned work orders in order to prioritize tasking. Document resolution and close completed work orders.
  • Accountable for offering technical guidance and mentoring of Computer Technicians with focus on accurate completion of work orders and execution of standard operating procedures.
  • Image, test, and install desktop/laptop computers for all new hire or temporary duty employees; this includes installing encryption tools and configuring wireless access as needed.
  • Perform and document preventive maintenance of computer equipment as required.
  • Facilitate vendor warranty return process, test and evaluate items returned from repair.
  • Responsible for maintaining physical inventories and ensuring accuracy as directed.
  • Participate in lifecycle replacement tasking and other technical improvement projects.
  • Manage retrograde efforts for all computer equipment, this includes performing DoD data wipe on all hard drives and preparing required documentation.
  • Carry duty pager and provide AV support during presentations outside of work hours as needed.
  • Responsible for maintaining a safe workplace program and ensuring that safety is the highest priority in the workplace.
  • Maintain an orderly work area and technical lab space clear of all hazards/debris.
  • Participate in the creation of technical and procedural documentation. Perform annual/seasonal review of documentation.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • U.S. citizenship or permanent residence is required.
  • High school diploma or equivalent required. AA degree in a technical discipline is preferred.
  • Minimum four years of experience in computer systems installation and maintenance, troubleshooting, wireless access configuration and support, in a corporate environment is required (all reasonable and related trade experience is acceptable).
  • Expert knowledge of Windows operating systems and applications is required.
  • Experience with DOS, Windows and Macintosh operating systems is required.
  • A+ and/or MCDST (Microsoft Certified Desktop Support Technician) are preferred.
  • Experience supporting business VPN access, disk imaging, and whole disk encryption is preferred.
  • UNIX and Linux knowledge is desired.

Competencies

  • Technical Capacity.
  • Organizational Skills.
  • Strategic Thinking.
  • Problem Solving/Analysis.

Physical Requirements

  • Deployment will be required in this position. The individual in the position must successfully complete the physical and dental examinations as required by the NSF for deploying to Antarctica. Failure to meet these requirements may result in withdrawal of employment offer or other employment action.
  • Complies with applicable safety, environment, health, and waste management policies and procedure.
  • Individual must be capable of operating a standard desktop computer; must be able to lift and carry up to 50 pounds.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Position Expectations

  • This is a full-time, seasonal position located in Antarctica.
  • All expenses paid while on-ice; meals, lodging, medical, gear, travel to and from Antarctica.
  • Candidate must be able to obtain a Public Trust Clearance.
  • Performance Period: October 2025-February 2026.

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer as defined by the EEOC.

title: Lula propõe transformar 2 de Julho em data nacional durante visita a Salvador
description:
Lula propõe transformar 2 de Julho em data nacional durante visita a Salvador

Presidente quer incluir a data nos livros didáticos e reforça papel da Bahia na independência do Brasil

Por: Redação

Compartilhe:

Presidente Lula assinou projeto de lei que torna o 2 de julho uma data nacional - Foto: Ricardo Stuckert

O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva está em Salvador para acompanhar, pelo quarto ano consecutivo, o desfile cívico do 2 de Julho. Em entrevista concedida ao Jornal da Manhã , da Rede Bahia, Lula comentou sobre a proposta de lei encaminhada ao Congresso Nacional na terça-feira, 1º, com o objetivo de transformar a data em um marco nacional.

Durante a entrevista, o presidente destacou o valor histórico da celebração e reforçou que a intenção do projeto é incluir o 2 de Julho nos livros didáticos. “As pessoas vão perceber que, com todo o respeito ao 7 de Setembro, o povo baiano foi quem expulsou os portugueses”, afirmou.

Reconhecimento histórico e audiovisual

Lula também revelou que já conversou com a ministra da Cultura, Margareth Menezes, para incentivar a produção de dez filmes sobre a história do Brasil, entre os quais o 2 de Julho deverá ser contemplado.

Sobre a possibilidade de criar um novo feriado nacional, o presidente ponderou: “O Brasil já tem muito feriado”. Ele ressaltou que o mais importante é o reconhecimento da data, já que “se você fizer uma pesquisa, 90% dos brasileiros não sabem o que aconteceu aqui”. Atualmente, o 2 de Julho já é feriado oficial no estado da Bahia.

Essa é uma oportunidade única para liderar a construção de uma operação logística do zero, com autonomia para estruturar processos, montar e desenvolver equipe, garantir compliance no setor farmacêutico e impulsionar inovação e eficiência. A logística molda o dia a dia – dos bens que consumimos aos cuidados de saúde dos quais dependemos. Na Kuehne+Nagel, seu trabalho vai além da logística; ele possibilita momentos comuns e especiais na vida de pessoas ao redor do mundo.

Como líder global com uma sólida herança e uma visão para impulsionar o mundo, oferecemos um ambiente seguro e estável onde sua carreira pode fazer a diferença. title: Prêmio Capes Futuras Cientistas está com inscrições abertas
description:
Prêmio Capes Futuras Cientistas está com inscrições abertas

Iniciativa quer incentivar a participação feminina em ciências exatas

Agência Brasil

O prêmio será concedido a 27 alunas, 27 professoras e 15 tutoras ao redor do Brasil | Foto: Marcello Casal Jr / Agência Brasil

As inscrições para a primeira edição do prêmio Capes Futuras Cientistas estão abertas a partir desta quarta-feira (10) e seguem até 16 de agosto. As candidatas estudantes, professoras e tutoras devem ser ex-participantes aprovadas no módulo Imersão Científica 2023 do Programa Futuras Cientistas, realizado pelo Cetene. As alunas devem ainda ter sido devidamente aprovadas para ingressar na graduação de uma universidade pública.

O resultado das vencedoras será publicado pela Capes, em outubro, no Diário Oficial da União. A entrega do prêmio ocorrerá em novembro.

Desde 2012, a iniciativa pretende identificar, dar visibilidade e valorizar alunas e educadoras de escolas públicas estaduais com o objetivo de incentivar o aumento da participação feminina nos espaços de desenvolvimento das áreas de ciências exatas, e contribuir para a equidade de gênero no mercado profissional.

O prêmio Capes Futuras Cientistas será concedido a 69 mulheres, sendo 27 estudantes, uma por unidade da federação.

No ato da inscrição devem ser apresentados documentos de identificação e CPF, declaração de matrícula da universidade pública. As candidatas selecionadas menores de 18 anos deverão ter autorização dos pais ou do representante legal para participar da competição.

Também serão premiadas 27 professoras, uma por estado, mais o Distrito Federal, além de 15 tutoras, sendo três de cada uma das cinco regiões do país, com projetos aprovados no programa.

As alunas vencedoras receberão certificado e medalha. Para as professoras e tutoras, a premiação consistirá no apoio financeiro, com valor máximo de R$ 6 mil, para a participação em congresso nacional relacionado à área de seu projeto de trabalho.

A premiação é coordenada pela Coordenação de Aperfeiçoamento de Pessoal de Nível Superior (Capes), vinculada ao Ministério da Educação (MEC), em parceria com o Centro de Tecnologias Estratégicas do Nordeste (Cetene), do Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação (MCTI).

Dúvidas sobre o edital podem ser esclarecidas pelos e-mails e ou pelo WhatsApp (81) 9 9713-2685.

title: Operador de Produção I
description:
O operador de produção é responsável pelo processo de enchimento de cilindros de diversos gases, garantindo que os cilindros sejam preenchidos de maneira segura e eficiente, seguindo todas as normas e regulamentações de segurança e qualidade.

1- Preparação e Inspeção:

· Manusear os cilindros manualmente, através de carrinhos e/ou com o auxílio da transpaleteira elétrica.

· Seguir orientações obrigatórias no Procedimento Operacional Padrão POP.008 de Inspeção de cilindros e a Instrução de Trabalho (IT).

· Inspecionar visualmente os cilindros quanto a danos, corrosão externa, deformações, defeitos, pintura, presença de graxa ou óleo antes do enchimento.

· Verificar a validade do teste hidrostático dos cilindros.

· Operar equipamento de lixadeira, caso as informações na calota do cilindro estejam ilegíveis.

· Cadastrar cilindros industriais e posteriormente colar a etiqueta de ID e/ou QRCODE.

· Garantir que os equipamentos incluindo válvulas e conexões, estejam em boas condições de funcionamento.

· Recusar o cilindro para o envase caso alguma não conformidade seja detectada, em caso de dúvidas o Encarregado ou Supervisor do setor deverá ser consultado.

2- Processo de enchimento:

· Operar equipamentos de enchimento de cilindros de gases seguindo o POP.009 e IT.

· Monitorar indicadores de pressão, painéis e temperatura durante o enchimento para garantir que os gases sejam armazenados de forma segura.

· Ajustar sistemas e reguladores conforme necessário para manter condições operacionais seguras.

· Preencher registros internos de produção.

3- Controle de Qualidade:

· Seguir as orientações descritas nos Procedimentos Operacionais.

· Auxiliar na triagem dos cilindros medicinais cheios para a análise ser efetuada pelo laboratório.

· Auxiliar o laboratório com os gases padrões na checagem de calibração dos analisadores.

· Remoção de materiais de embalagem (etiquetas e lacres) antigos dos cilindros industriais.

· Realizar testes para verificação de vazamento na válvula dos cilindros.

· Realizar teste para checagem de pressão final dos cilindros após o envase.

· Etiquetar e lacrar os cilindros industriais após envase.

· Preencher registros internos de produção.

4- Manuseio de Equipamentos:

· Zelar e garantir a boa condição dos equipamentos, utensílios e ferramentas: transpaleteira elétrica, gaiolas, carrinhos, painéis, bombas, balanças, flexíveis, manômetros, lixadeira, entre outros.

· Preencher registros internos.

5- Manutenção e Limpeza

· Realizar a limpeza e a manutenção básica dos equipamentos de enchimento.

· Garantir que a área de trabalho esteja limpa e organizada ao final de cada turno.

description:

A ATS (Amazon Transportation Services) está procurando por pessoas motivadas para ajudar a desenvolver um processo logístico de classe mundial que entregue mercadorias no prazo e com o melhor custo. O objetivo da nossa equipe é gerenciar com excelência a execução do frete que flui através de nossas redes de transporte, focada especificamente no gerenciamento, desenvolvimento, qualidade e desempenho de transportadoras.
Esse papel exige por uma pessoa ambiciosa. Você representará uma função crítica em nossas operações de transporte mais amplas na Amazon, enquanto trabalhamos para melhorar continuamente os níveis de serviço, prezando pela segurança em nossas instalações. Isso nos ajudará a garantir que as promessas feitas aos nossos valiosos clientes sejam cumpridas sempre.
Uma pessoa especialista em operações de transporte facilita o fluxo de informações entre diferentes partes interessadas (transportadoras/hubs/armazéns) e resolve quaisquer possíveis problemas que afetem a experiência do cliente e a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, trabalhará em operações externas com relacionamento Sort Center/Carrier, garantindo que o caminhão saia do SC para entregar os pedidos dos clientes conforme a promessa. Essa pessoa também monitora a chegada da nossa frota e aborda quaisquer possíveis problemas que ocorram durante o ciclo de vida do frete saindo do FC/SC e chegando às instalações do cliente.
Como especialista em transporte, você deve ser capaz de solucionar o problema em tempo hábil pesquisando e consultando ferramentas internas e tomando decisões em tempo real. Você deve ser capaz de entender os requisitos/ser capaz de analisar dados e observar tendências e ser capaz de impulsionar a experiência do cliente sem comprometer o tempo. Ter o conhecimento básico de Logística e deve ser capaz de se comunicar claramente na forma escrita e oral, também é necessário. A pessoa deve ser capaz de idealizar melhorias no processo e ter o zelo de levá-las à conclusão.
Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os amazonians a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Não só celebramos a diversidade de nossa força de trabalho, mas também as diversas formas de trabalhar. Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para o processo de entrevista ou integração, informe nossa equipe e nós o conectaremos à nossa equipe de acomodação.
Essa função funcionará em turnos 3x2 das 18h às 5h
Key job responsibilities
Comunicação com clientes externos (transportadoras, fornecedores/fornecedores) e clientes internos (varejo, finanças, suporte de software, centros de atendimento, estações de entrega, centros de classificação).
Capacidade de extrair dados de vários bancos de dados (usando Excel, Access, SQL e/ou outros sistemas de gerenciamento de dados) e realizar relatórios e análises ad hoc conforme necessário é uma vantagem.
Desenvolver e/ou compreender métricas de desempenho para ajudar a impulsionar os resultados comerciais.
Deve ser capaz de entender rapidamente o impacto comercial das tendências e tomar decisões que façam sentido com base nos dados disponíveis.
Deve ser capaz de encaminhar sistematicamente problemas ou variações nas informações e dados para os proprietários e equipes relevantes e cumprir as resoluções para garantir que sejam entregues.
Trabalhe dentro de várias restrições de tempo para atender às necessidades críticas dos negócios, ao mesmo tempo em que mede e identifica as atividades realizadas.
Excelente comunicação, tanto verbal quanto escrita, para criar uma narrativa descrevendo as descobertas semanais e as variações das metas, e apresentá-las em um fórum de revisão.
Suporta o monitoramento da chegada de veículos, correta alocação de veículos no horário necessário para carregamento, nas docas corretas, respeitando todos os padrões de segurança Amazon.
Responder às atividades de agendamento de veículos.
Prioriza-define a alocação dos veículos em doca.

title: Sales Development Representative - US Market
description:
Job Description

A little about us

xChange is the world’s first online B2B marketplace to trade and lease shipping containers. We are a Series B startup with the ambition to become the world’s first and favorite place to buy containers, empowering local traders to seamlessly source and resell boxes while serving as the go-to sales channel for original equipment owners and wholesalers.

Our team of 50+ like-minded xChangees from a great variety of nationalities has made this possible! We have scaled far beyond the small start-up we once were and continue to disrupt the industry together.

The Role

Your next opportunity—what you'll be doing and how you'll make an impact.

As a Sales Development Representative, you will play a key role in driving high-volume B2B sales of shipping containers. This is a highly transactional sales role where you’ll be responsible for managing the entire sales cycle—from sourcing and qualifying leads to closing deals. You will actively identify customer demand, respond quickly to inquiries, and match clients with available container inventory.

Your day-to-day will involve high outbound activity, conducting calls and emails, negotiating pricing, and building strong relationships with our B2B clients. Since you’ll be targeting the U.S. market, fluency in English is essential, and prior experience working with American clients or markets is highly preferred.

Location

Where you'll be based and how we collaborate globally.

Our headquarters is located in the heart of Hamburg, Germany, with team members distributed across the globe. This is a hybrid position based in São Paulo, Brazil , where you’ll regularly collaborate in person with local colleagues to share ideas and drive customer success while having the flexibility to work from home as well. Since you’ll be targeting the U.S. market, U.S. time zone is required.

Requirements

Your Impact

What you'll own, drive, and contribute to our success.

  • Identify and qualify new B2B sales opportunities for the US market by understanding customer container needs and matching them with available inventory
  • Act as the first point of contact through outbound calls, emails, and networking to generate, capture and convert demand
  • Build and manage a pipeline of prospects, closing container deals in a fast-paced, transactional sales environment
  • Collaborate closely with the marketing team to optimize lead quality, outreach strategies, and market targeting
  • Use Pipedrive to track leads, monitor sales performance, and gain insights to continuously improve conversion rates

What Makes You a Great Fit?

The experience, skills, and mindset that will help you thrive.

  • You bring hands-on experience in B2B sales backed by experience in cold calling and outbound prospecting —ideally within a fast-paced transactional sales environment
  • You are a self-starter, highly motivated and driven who confidently drives sales through persistence and a positive attitude
  • You excel at building and managing customer relationships, understanding client needs, and turning demand into closed deals
  • Your strong pipeline management skills, persuasive negotiation abilities, and clear communication style help you drive results
  • You think entrepreneurial, act proactively, and stay organized while handling multiple leads and fast-moving opportunities
  • You're a team player who thrives in a collaborative environment, stays adaptable in a dynamic market, and brings the drive and resilience needed to hit ambitious sales targets

What to Expect

Insights into perks, culture, and earning potential.

Earning potential: As a part of our sales team, you will have an attractive uncapped commission package motivating you to not only hit your targets but exceed them as a true hunter.

Ownership & impact at xChange: You will have a direct stake in xChange as a shareholder with a competitive virtual equity package! You will also have full ownership and trust to drive impactful topics, supported by smart and driven individuals. Plus, get personal coaching and counseling for both professional development and personal support through our partnership with Nilo.health.

xChange culture & collaboration: Our diverse and talented team operates with flat hierarchies and a growth-focused mindset which fosters an open-minded, collaborative, and high-performance driven culture where A-players thrive.

AI Focus: We believe AI is a game-changer for sales success. At xChange, you’ll get hands-on experience with AI tools designed to streamline sales operations, enhance your skills, and boost your conversion rates. This is a unique opportunity to grow alongside AI technologies that will empower you to work smarter and close more deals.

Other perks at xChange: 36 vacation days for remote employees outside of Germany, mental healthcare & coaching program, language courses and many more. Feel free to ask the Talent team for details

If this sounds like your future job, all we need is your CV which you can submit through the application link!

title: AUXILIAR FATURAMENTO
description:
O Assistente de Faturamento é responsável por assegurar a emissão correta e eficiente de documentos fiscais relacionados às operações de gases medicinais e industriais. Essa função é crucial para o bom andamento dos processos financeiros e logísticos da empresa, garantindo o cumprimento das legislações vigentes e a satisfação dos clientes através da precisão e eficiência em suas atividades.

Formação Educacional: Formação técnica ou cursando superior em Contabilidade, Administração, Finanças ou áreas relacionadas

Experiência Desejada: Experiência prévia em funções de faturamento, finanças ou contabilidade será um diferencial.

Experiência no uso de software TOTVs será um diferencial.

1. Emissão de Notas Fiscais:

· Emitir notas fiscais para vendas, devoluções, remessas, transferências, bonificações e consertos, garantindo que todas estejam em conformidade com a legislação fiscal vigente e as especificações do setor.

· Quando efetuar vendas para outro estado a não contribuintes, deverá informar ao setor Fiscal para seguir corretamente as exigências fiscais, incluindo a geração da Guia Nacional de Recolhimento de Tributos Estaduais (GNRE).

· Verificar e corrigir as notas ficais rejeitadas pela SEFAZ.

2. Gestão de Ordens e Notas de Serviços:

· Emitir ordens e notas fiscais de serviços, de forma precisa, assegurando que todos os processos sejam realizados de acordo com as normas internas e legislações.

3. Suporte Técnico para Motoristas:

· Oferecer suporte aos motoristas na utilização de tablets para emissão de notas fiscais e cadastro de clientes, garantindo que todos os dados sejam registrados corretamente.

4. Conferência e Fechamento de Viagem:

· Realizar analise da carga confrontando a conferencia física realizada pela área de logística com dados da nota fiscal e as informações registradas no sistema. Durante essa etapa, é crucial identificar qualquer discrepância entre os itens recebidos e os documentação. Em caso de detecção de anomalias, proceder com as correções necessárias nos registros. Após a correção dos erros, o próximo passo é concluir a viagem no sistema, assegurando que ele reflete com precisão a situação existente.

· Repasse físico do acerto de viagem ao setor financeiro.

5. Emissão e Despacho de Manifestos:

· Preparar e despachar manifestos que acompanharão as cargas, facilitando a logística até o cliente final de forma eficiente e conforme os requisitos legais.

6. Controle de Cilindros e Matéria-Prima:

· Gerenciar o controle de cilindros nos clientes e nas instalações da empresa, bem como o controle de matéria-prima por lotes, para garantir a rastreabilidade e o uso eficiente dos recursos.

7. Organização de Faturamentos para Protocolação – Fundo municipal de Rio Verde:

· Separar e organizar os faturamentos destinados ao fundo de Rio Verde, garantindo sua correta protocolação na Secretaria de Saúde, UPA e SAMU da cidade, em conformidade com os prazos e requisitos estabelecidos.

· Informar a área comercial e fiscal via e-mail, os recolhimentos de cilindros cheios.

8. Orientações a cliente e colaboradores:

· Prestar suporte, orientando clientes e colaboradores sobre processos da área de faturamento.

Job description

Sobre o Time:

O Coordenador Comercial será peça-chave na estratégia de vendas da Trinus, atuando na gestão e execução de processos comerciais para um portfólio diversificado de empreendimentos na região Sul do país. Seu papel será híbrido, equilibrando planejamento estratégico e operação prática, garantindo o sucesso das vendas e a sinergia entre mercado, parceiros e objetivos da empresa.

Embora não tenha uma equipe subordinada direta, esse profissional exercerá liderança indireta sobre corretores, imobiliárias, fornecedores e parceiros de vendas, sendo o ponto central da gestão comercial.


Main responsibilities

Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Desenvolver e executar estratégias comerciais e de vendas, alinhadas aos objetivos dos empreendimentos e às particularidades de cada produto;
  • Monitorar o funil de vendas, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e implementar ações para otimizar os resultados;
  • Atuar diretamente em negociações estratégicas e complexas, garantindo a satisfação do cliente e o fechamento de negócios de alto valor;
  • Gerenciar o relacionamento com corretores, imobiliárias, fornecedores e parceiros, promovendo engajamento, alinhamento e alta performance;
  • Planejar e conduzir treinamentos e ações de capacitação para equipes de vendas, elevando a excelência no atendimento e na execução comercial;
  • Apoiar diretamente em operações comerciais, eventos e negociações, garantindo que as estratégias sejam bem executadas e os resultados atingidos;
  • Realizar estudos de mercado e análise da concorrência, identificando tendências e oportunidades para ajustes estratégicos;
  • Utilizar CRM e ferramentas de análise de dados para monitorar performance comercial, propor melhorias e elaborar relatórios gerenciais;
  • Revisar tabelas de vendas e estratégias comerciais, garantindo a competitividade e a eficiência operacional.

Requirements and skills

O que buscamos em você:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Marketing, Gestão Comercial ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em vendas e gestão de equipes comerciais, preferencialmente no mercado imobiliário (urbanismo e incorporação – vertical e horizontal);
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em análise de mercado, concorrência e comportamento do consumidor para orientar decisões estratégicas;
  • Domínio de CRM e ferramentas de análise de dados para monitoramento da performance comercial;
  • Capacidade de planejamento estratégico e execução de ações voltadas para o alcance de resultados;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial na Região Sul (Chapecó, Maringá, Passo Fundo, Cascavel) e viagens frequentes conforme demanda comercial.

Critérios que aumentam o match com a vaga:

  • Conhecimento atualizado sobre regulamentações e práticas específicas do mercado imobiliário;
  • Experiência com negociações de alto valor e estratégias de pricing;
  • Habilidade para gerenciar múltiplas demandas e prioridades com foco na entrega de resultados;
  • Perfil analítico e orientado a dados, com facilidade para interpretar métricas e traduzir insights em ações comerciais estratégicas.

Additional information

O que oferecemos aqui:

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição/Mobilidade (Cartão Swille);
  • Vale Cultura (Cartão Swille);
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Educação Corporativa;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Parcerias com Instituições de Ensino;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Licença Paternidade Estendida;
  • Bônus Anual.

Além disso, gostamos de destacar:

  • Oportunidade de trocar conhecimentos diários com um time de referência no mercado;
  • Na Trinus, prezamos pelo bem-estar, pelo trabalho em equipe e acreditamos que, com liberdade e responsabilidade, chegaremos ainda mais longe;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento;
  • Nosso time possui uma capacidade de mobilização única!

Essa vaga está aberta à candidatura de todas as pessoas — independentemente de suas características ou condições quanto à etnia, gênero, orientação sexual, acessibilidade, cultural, social ou qualquer outro fator.

Reforçamos: todas as nossas vagas estão e sempre estarão abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PCDs).

title: Black Island Domestic Supporter Coordinator - McMurdo, Antarctica (Austral Summer 2025)
description:
Job Description

Position Title: Black Island Domestic Support Coordinator

Location: Black Island Telecommunications Facility, Antarctica

Reports To: Black Island Telecommunications Facility Manager

About the Role

The Black Island Domestic Support Coordinator is a critical member of a two-person team responsible for maintaining operations and domestic support at the Black Island Telecommunications Facility. This remote Antarctic station plays a vital role in providing backup off-continent data communications and television services to McMurdo Station, Antarctica.

The role demands exceptional adaptability, teamwork, and resourcefulness in a highly remote and challenging environment. The successful candidate will coordinate logistical and domestic operations, maintain the facility, and ensure the comfort and functionality of the station for its two permanent residents and visiting personnel.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Coordination and Reporting
    • Coordinate McMurdo staff, maintenance personnel, and distinguished visitor site visits to Black Island.
    • Communicate daily population reports for Black Island to relevant authorities at McMurdo Station.
  2. Food Services
    • Plan and prepare meals for station residents and visitors (up to 10 people at a time).
    • Maintain inventory of the food cache, including ordering and restocking as needed.
    • Ensure the availability of fresh water by collecting and processing snow for drinking and cooking purposes.
  3. Station Maintenance and Cleanliness
    • Maintain the cleanliness of the station, including common areas and shared living quarters.
    • Coordinate transportation of laundry to McMurdo Station for station staff.
    • Monitor propane tank levels and coordinate resupply as necessary.
  4. Team Collaboration
    • Work closely with the Black Island Telecommunications Facility Manager to support facility maintenance and domestic operations.
    • Assist with snow removal, minor repairs, and operational tasks as required.
    • Serve as "remote hands" as needed to assist communications experts located in McMurdo or Denver with maintenance tasks.
    • Replace and manage human waste containers as needed.
  5. Visitor and Station Support
    • Ensure smooth operations during visits from staff and distinguished guests by coordinating logistics and maintaining a welcoming environment.
    • Adapt to dynamic operational demands, prioritizing tasks effectively.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Ability to thrive in a remote and isolated environment with shared bunkhouse-style living arrangements.
  • Excellent organizational and coordination skills.
  • Experience in meal planning, preparation, and food inventory management.
  • Strong communication skills for daily reporting and coordination.
  • Proactive problem-solving ability and resourcefulness in challenging conditions.
  • Physical fitness and willingness to perform manual labor, such as snow removal and equipment maintenance.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with a small team in high-pressure, variable conditions.
  • Familiarity with basic maintenance tasks, particularly in a facility setting, is an asset.

Living and Working Conditions

Black Island is a remote Antarctic facility with extreme weather conditions and limited resources. The living quarters are shared in a bunkhouse-style arrangement with personally maintained temporary dividers for privacy. The position requires flexibility, adaptability, and a positive attitude toward communal living and work in a demanding environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in remote or austere environments.
  • Experience working in facilities management, domestic support, or logistics.
  • Knowledge of or experience in Antarctica or similar remote areas.

Position Expectations

  • This is a full-time, seasonal position located in Antarctica.
  • All expenses paid while on-ice; meals, lodging, medical, gear, travel to and from Antarctica.
  • Performance Period: Oct 2025 - Feb 2026

This is a unique opportunity for a highly adaptable and collaborative individual to contribute to critical operations in one of the most remote and challenging environments on Earth.

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer as defined by the EEOC.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring Associate Sales Operations Analysts to support a team of experts who help Canonical sales teams achieve their business goals. The Sales Operations team drives continuous process and data quality improvement to ensure orders are processed correctly. The successful candidate will be collaborative and demonstrate initiative in improving the way the team works, maintaining compliance and associated governance.
The success of the role is measured against increasing the velocity of deals and the quality of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) data used to drive key business decisions. The ideal candidate will be detail oriented problem solver and team player who is passionate about the opportunity to partner with sales teams, is also passionate about our role in the technology industry bringing open source to a wider audience of innovators and enterprises, and will support the delivery of programs to enable Canonical's continued success.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region.
The role entails:

  • Support all aspects of the day-to-day operations of the sales function globally
  • Check opportunities for accuracy and provision orders on successful closure of a deal
  • Support the Sales Operations Analysts and Manager to report on and improve sales data quality and processes
  • Support the sales team globally on CRM and other sales operations systems
  • Deliver sales metrics, dashboards and other ad-hoc analytical tasks
  • Assist the team with automation and streamlining of the Lead to Order process
What we are looking for in you:
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and university
  • Experience working in an entry-level role in sales operations or related (e.g. financial analysis, sales analysis or sales order processing), preferably in the technology industry
  • Energetic, thoughtful, systematic approach, focused on robust, repeatable and scalable outcomes
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to work productively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization on a global scale
  • Ability to work across team boundaries and communicate effectively
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
What Canonical offers
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Research Engineer / Scientist
description:
About Avra

Avra is a deep tech data intelligence platform powered by foundational AI that translates the complexity of SMEs into strategic decisions for large enterprises. We develop our own foundational models from the ground up—without relying on third-party solutions—to deliver innovative insights that empower some of the leading banks and fintechs across Latin America. Founded in 2024 by Bruno Alano (ex-OpenAI) and Viviane Meister, our team brings together expertise from NVIDIA, Palantir, Google, and more to drive real impact.

About the Role

In this role, you will define and execute an applied research agenda at the frontier of AI. You will build and optimize our entire ML pipeline—from data collection and preparation to training, evaluation, and production monitoring—while developing novel architectures that push the boundaries of what's possible. You'll fine-tune our foundational models for diverse client applications, and work on innovative solutions involving massive datasets and cutting-edge research.

Additionally, you'll have the opportunity to work with global AI advisors who are leaders in research worldwide, and join a team that was selected by AWS as one of the three model builders in LATAM.

Responsibilities

  • Innovative Model Architecture: Design, implement, and refine new machine learning and deep learning architectures by staying current with academic research and reading relevant papers daily.

  • End-to-End Pipeline Management: Build, test, and monitor robust data pipelines and training processes, ensuring scalability and reliability in production environments.

  • Model Fine-Tuning & Customization: Adapt and optimize our foundational models for various client needs, leveraging experimentation and hyperparameter tuning platforms.

  • Application Development: Develop diverse AI-driven applications that integrate seamlessly with our platform, translating research insights into real-world solutions.

  • Product Integration: Collaborate with engineering and product teams to transform complex business challenges into technical solutions that harness the power of frontier research.

  • Technical Leadership: Take full technical ownership of research projects, making strategic decisions that directly influence the evolution of our products.

You Stand Out If

  • You have deep, hands-on experience with PyTorch or similar deep learning frameworks.

  • You are passionate about frontier research, routinely exploring academic literature to drive innovation.

  • You have a track record of working with complex data pipelines and large-scale machine learning systems.

  • You’re experienced in experimenting with and fine-tuning models using advanced hyperparameter tuning platforms.

  • Experience with graph-based models is a plus.

  • You thrive in a dynamic, cross-functional team environment and are comfortable taking full responsibility for your projects.

Qualifications

  • Experience: At least 5 years in designing, implementing, and monitoring impactful machine learning models.

  • Academic Background: Bachelor’s degree (preferably with a specialization or Master’s) in Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

  • Technical Proficiency: Extensive experience with modern deep learning frameworks (preferably PyTorch) and a solid understanding of state-of-the-art modeling techniques.

  • Research Mindset: Strong ability to design experiments, evaluate model performance, and implement algorithmic improvements based on the latest research.

  • Collaboration: Excellent communication skills and experience working in agile, cross-functional teams.

Differentiators

  • Prior experience with distributed systems and processing large volumes of data.

  • Exposure to graph-based models and related technologies.

  • Active involvement in applied AI research, including publications or contributions to the research community.

  • Familiarity with MLOps practices for model deployment and production integration.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Compensation: Attractive salary, equity participation, and full transparency in our compensation package.

  • Autonomy and Impact: Work directly with our founders and technical leadership, with the freedom to shape the direction of groundbreaking research.

  • Cutting-Edge Environment: Engage in frontier research, working with huge amounts of data and developing models that have real-world impact across diverse applications.

  • Global Expertise: Benefit from the guidance of global AI advisors and join a team recognized by AWS as one of the three model builders in LATAM.

  • Flexible Culture: Enjoy 100% remote work with access to our São Paulo office, unlimited vacation, and a comprehensive benefits package including a national health plan and extended parental leave.

If you’re driven by a passion for innovative research and eager to push the limits of AI while working with massive datasets and groundbreaking architectures, we’d love to hear from you.

Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas;
Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala;
Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado;
Comprometimento com o desenvolvimento dos alunos, avaliando os resultados e fornecendo feedback para melhorar seu desempenho;
Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

  8. Utilizar e garantir a performance dos equipamentos utilizados pelo departamento visando reduzir custos e agilizar a divulgação das informações necessárias.

  13. Cumprir normas e procedimentos de controle de infecção hospitalar.

Na dsm-firmenich, ser uma força do bem não é opcional. Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão é uma responsabilidade compartilhada integrada em nosso trabalho diário, beneficiando nossas Pessoas, Clientes e Comunidades e gerando valor comercial. A igualdade de acesso às oportunidades é um dado adquirido, a pertença é um sentimento partilhado, a autenticidade é celebrada.
Suas principais responsabilidades

  • Manter o sistema em regime de normalidade operacional com objetivo de preparar e conscientizar os colaboradores envolvidos com as atividades de manutenção, para apontamentos e registros das tarefas executadas, incluindo também, o registro das horas de equipamentos e máquinas paradas e causas das avarias;
  • Responsável pela gestão da equipe de execução de manutenção, acompanhando as atividades corretivas e preventivas na planta, assegurando que todos os processos estejam em conformidade com os procedimentos e padrões estabelecidos pela DSM-Firmenich.
  • Gestão da equipe de manutenção composta por mecânicos, eletricistas e eletromecânicos, garantindo a execução eficiente das atividades de manutenção conforme os padrões e diretrizes da DSM-Firmenich.
  • Gestão dos indicadores de manutenção, atuando em conjunto com a engenharia de confiabilidade para aumentar a disponibilidade dos equipamentos e evitar quebras inesperadas. Atuação próxima ao PPCM (Planejamento, Programação e Controle de Manutenção), garantindo a aderência aos planos e prevenindo desvios no cronograma de manutenção.
  • Revisar o cadastro das ordens de serviço sistemáticas relacionadas aos planos de manutenção dos equipamentos e máquinas, assegurando a correção das periodicidades e a aderência às estratégias de manutenção.
  • Fiscalizar a execução dos planos de manutenção sistemática e não sistemática, originados por inspeções ou check-lists, garantindo que contenham todas as informações necessárias para as áreas solicitantes da organização.
Você proporciona
  • Ensino Superior Completo (Engenharia – desejável)
  • Curso Técnico em Mecânica, Eletromecânica ou Eletrônica
  • Atuação na área de Manutenção Industrial em plantas de processo
  • Vivência com elaboração de escopos de manutenção, coordenação e implementação de melhorias
  • Capacidade de engajar e mobilizar pessoas
  • Perfil voltado à inovação e melhoria contínua
Nós proporcionamos
  • Um espaço para crescer incentivando e apoiando a curiosidade e uma mentalidade aberta;
  • Uma cultura que prioriza a segurança e o bem-estar, tanto físico quanto menta
  • Um ambiente de trabalho flexível que capacita as pessoas a assumir a responsabilidade por seu trabalho e assumir o resultado;
  • A oportunidade de trabalhar em uma empresa onde a sustentabilidade é muito mais que uma reivindicação e está no centro de nossa estratégia e propósito;
  • Atuar em uma empresa que ofereça oportunidades de crescimento profissional e desenvolvimento contínuo.
  • Uma história rica e um futuro promissor de inovação científica ousada e criação apaixonada com nossos clientes
Como se candidatar
Interessado neste cargo? Inscreva-se on-line enviando o seu currículo por meio do nosso portal de carreiras. Geralmente, o procedimento estará de acordo com o processo de candidatura descrito no site de carreiras da dsm-firmenich. Em razão das normas de privacidade, só podemos interagir ativamente com as candidaturas por meio do portal de carreiras.
Compromisso de Igualdade de Oportunidade
A dsm-firmenich está totalmente dedicada à inclusão porque quando as pessoas se sentem envolvidas e capacitadas, a sua criatividade e inovação impulsionam um progresso sem precedentes. Nosso objetivo é construir um local de trabalho onde as oportunidades sejam realmente iguais, para que todos possam prosperar. Não discriminamos: (aqui) tem lugar para todos conosco.
dsm-firmenich é um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais e ações afirmativas. Nosso pessoal é tão diversificado quanto nossos clientes. Para nós, isso inclui o compromisso de garantir oportunidades iguais de emprego para todos os candidatos a empregos e funcionários. As decisões de emprego são baseadas em motivos relacionados ao trabalho, independentemente da raça, cor, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, idade, nacionalidade, deficiência, estado civil, informação genética, status de veterano protegido ou qualquer outro status protegido por lei.
Estamos empenhados em fornecer apoio razoável aos candidatos com deficiência no nosso processo de recrutamento. Se você precisar de ajuda e se sentir confortável em compartilhar isso, informe-nos.
Sobre a dsm-firmenich
Como inovadores em nutrição, saúde e beleza, a dsm-firmenich reinventa, fábrica e combina nutrientes, sabores e fragrâncias vitais para que a crescente população mundial prospere. Com a nossa gama abrangente de soluções, com ingredientes naturais e renováveis e capacidades científicas e tecnológicas de renome, trabalhamos para criar o que é essencial para a vida, desejável para os consumidores e mais sustentável para o planeta. A dsm-firmenich é uma empresa suíço-holandesa, cotada na Euronext Amsterdam, com operações em quase 60 países e receitas superiores a 12 mil milhões de euros. Com uma equipe diversificada e mundial de quase 30.000 funcionários, damos vida ao progresso todos os dias, em qualquer lugar, para bilhões de pessoas.

We are looking for a Principal Genesys Cloud PS Consultant to join our team. Qualifications
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in maintaining and optimizing large, multi-site, complex contact center environments.

  • Culture of Relentless Performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth.

  • Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.

  • Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events.
  • Social Sustainability Values: join oursustainable business practicesfocused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

title: Data Engineer
description:
About Avra

Avra is a deep tech data intelligence platform powered by foundational AI that translates the complexity of SMEs into strategic decisions for large enterprises. We develop our own foundational models from the ground up—without relying on third-party solutions—to deliver innovative insights that empower some of the leading banks and fintechs across Latin America. Founded in 2024 by Bruno Alano (ex-OpenAI) and Viviane Meister, our team brings together expertise from NVIDIA, Palantir, Google, and more to drive real impact.

About the Role

At Avra, we’re building a data platform from the ground up — one that will serve as a trusted foundation for both our products and the AI models we develop. As a Senior Data Engineer, you’ll play a key role in designing and delivering this infrastructure, ensuring that critical data flows reliably, securely, and with full governance across systems and teams.

Our challenge goes far beyond ingestion and transformation: we’re focused on creating a robust data foundation that supports multiple consumers — from product teams to research — each with varying levels of experimentation, performance, and traceability. This mission involves making long-term architectural decisions while also shipping tactical solutions that deliver immediate value.

You’ll be responsible for designing, evolving, and maintaining the core components of our data platform, working closely with engineers, data scientists, and technical stakeholders to ensure our data is always ready for use — with quality, context, and full lineage.

Responsibilities

  • Data Lakehouse Architecture : Design and manage scalable Iceberg-based table structures on AWS and GCP, enabling time travel, versioning, and high-performance analytics.

  • Pipeline Engineering : Develop and maintain batch and streaming ETL pipelines using Spark, Ray, AWS Glue, Kinesis, and Airflow (MWAA).

  • Graph Management: Maintain and update our heterogeneous relationship graph.

  • Infrastructure as Code : Use Terraform and CI/CD to provision, deploy, and version control the entire data stack — from S3 buckets and IAM roles to Glue Jobs and DataSync.

  • Architecture Design: Develop robust data architectures that facilitate efficient storage, retrieval, and processing of high-volume data.

  • Best Practices: Implement and promote data quality, security, and scalability standards across all engineering practices.

title: Senior Producer
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PRODUCTION What We Do

Whether it’s driving a vision from start to finish or collaborating with teams to inspire and deliver projects of Epic quality, Epic’s production teams take pride in consistently delivering world-class products and experiences.

What You'll Do

As a Senior Producer focused on the Fortnite Ecosystem Team, you will partner with cross-discipline leadership on the development of the Creator Portal, Creator Economy, and multi-game initiatives on our platform. Your role is pivotal in ensuring that our roadmap works towards achieving our goals and that we are effectively prioritizing the tools and features we release, drawing upon Creator feedback as well as product research and insights to inform the team's decisions. We are looking for individuals who excel in organization, have exceptional communication abilities, and are comfortable managing schedules of complex projects. The ideal candidates are passionate about technology and games and have a history of working with webtech and UIUX teams within technical and distributed environments.

In this role, you will
  • Lead roadmap planning activities for your initiatives, including feedback collection, requirements gathering, initiative build-out, feature breakdown, estimations, and resourcing in order to drive a solid roadmap that achieves defined strategic product goals
  • Partner with discipline leads to determine the time and people necessary to see projects through to completion. Build and maintain project plans, schedules, resource allocations, and roadmaps, considering dependencies across multiple development teams, to ensure successful releases
  • Provide transparent communications on project status and risks to stakeholders to ensure they are properly informed of any impacts from upcoming releases
  • Partner with multiple leaders to understand and balance priorities, requirements, and critical timelines
  • Collaborate with producers and other disciplines on the development teams needed to complete initiatives, and communicate frequently and proactively to highlight progress, risks, and mitigations
  • Manage both internal and external resources globally as they pertain to resource allocation, budget forecasts, and actuals
  • Leave things better than you find them, with an eye toward continual process development and improvements based on the needs of the teams/initiatives/product
What we're looking for
  • Experience with online services, platform technologies, or SaaS systems
  • Previous experience working in a production role where you've managed cross-functional teams in creating and delivering complex projects
  • Deep understanding of game or platform development, software development process, and project management practices
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • A good knowledge of light-touch production systems that allow teams to thrive without unnecessary overhead
  • Have the ability to communicate with varying levels of stakeholders within your team and throughout the company
  • A passion for UGC networks and or publishing portals is a plus
  • Specific interest and familiarity with Fortnite Creative and UEFN
EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of engineering experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

We are looking for a Senior Technical Artist (Lookdev) to join the MetaHuman art team. This is an opportunity to work alongside our talented team of artists, engineers, and researchers to push our character technology, particularly around materials, lighting, and rendering. As part of this team, you play an important role in supporting our existing product and future-facing character technology. You will be responsible for supporting the Technical Art team in ensuring MetaHuman content continually improves visual fidelity and remains scalable and optimized for target platforms. The ideal candidate would be proactive, experienced in real-time rendering and photorealistic look development, and passionate about collaborating with researchers and engineers to develop our character technology.

In this role, you will

  • Work closely with Art and Engineering teams to deliver high-quality, optimized content for target platforms
  • Collaborate with engineers to profile digital character technology on target platforms and help define art budgets
  • Support R&D initiatives centered around digital characters
  • Drive improvements in the visual fidelity of MetaHumans

What we're looking for

  • A strong reel/portfolio demonstrating photorealistic character lookdev and authoring content suitable for real-time rendering
  • Deep understanding of physically based rendering and photorealistic character look-development workflows
  • Self-motivated and proactive in looking for ways to improve the product and push for future technology
  • 5+ years of experience using Unreal Engine and working in a game dev environment
  • Experience with DCCs such as Substance, Houdini, Maya
  • Proficient with creating content optimized for real-time rendering
  • Confident with scripting languages such as Python

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

description:
EBANX is a global fintech founded in 2012 with a mission to connect global and regional companies to consumers in Latin America. With its own technology and infrastructure, combined with in-depth knowledge of the Latin American market, EBANX allows these companies to connect to hundreds of payment methods in different countries in the region. And it goes further, creating results for businesses and simple shopping experiences for consumers.

From the beginning of our journey, we have an important mission: to give access . And this is not just about our products and services, but it goes through everything we are and do. We believe that it is only possible to innovate with diversity, so we cherish differences in gender, race, nationality, disability, sexual orientation, religion and age. Plurality is what makes our Big Dream possible.

We are called ebankers and we are changing the way people buy, connect, and live globally. Let's make history together?

You will work in a team of experienced developers and be responsible for maintaining a platform that processes millions of transactional requests every day. We cultivate an engineering culture that values and promotes sustainable quality, continuous delivery, high availability, quick feedback, and meritocracy.

As an EBANX leader you will be responsible for:

  • Managing a highly qualified and technical team;
  • Contribute and collaborate with the product areas and the development engineering team;
  • Have fun doing the management of technical teams and enabling the delivery of relevant products with global impact;
  • Create and send weekly reports on the progress of the team's activities to stakeholders;
  • Doing thorough code-reviews and help your teammates with complex designs and architectural decisions;
  • Testing and following your code to production continuously;
  • Working on strategic projects for EBANX;
  • Evolving and deciding the future of our payments platform;
  • A system of high availability (+ 99.9%) and with high throughput (100+ TPS), written in PHP, and MySQL (yes, it is possible :smile:). Don't know PHP? No problems, the important thing is to master the basics!
  • Mentoring and developing new talents;

What is indispensable for the job?

  • Proven experience of at least 5 years designing, implementing, and deploying software solutions to production;
  • Proven experience of at least 2 years leading a team of software engineers;
  • Interest in subjects such as data structures, concurrency, persistence, and distributed systems;
  • Expertise in git or any other collaborative version control system;
  • A vision for software quality, the evolution of systems, decomposition of problems and abstractions;
  • A great ability to learn new practices, technologies, programming languages and absorbing engineering culture;
  • Advanced English (read, write and speak);

What would we love to see?

  • Passion for software, you go to sleep and wake up thinking about how to make that part of the system more elegant or efficient;
  • Fluent English, we have customers from all around the world and it is commonplace for us to speak and write English when helping, supporting, and writing specifications with them;
  • Software development expertise in any complementary area to our core business, such as data warehouses, specialized development platforms, infrastructure automation, services provisioning, real-time systems, fault-tolerant systems, and mission-critical systems;
  • Experience with deploying to and monitoring a cloud infrastructure especially AWS.
  • Experience with computer networks, latency, package loss, routing optimization, monitoring, and problem-solving;
  • Full knowledge of SQL and relational databases;
  • Test-driven development: you don't even remember how to code without a very extensive test coverage; You often write the tests first and then the code.
  • Expertise in at least one functional or logic programming language -- besides SQL ;)
  • Comfortable with challenges of concurrency problems and has already worked in distributed and asynchronous systems;
  • Knowledge of data replication and conciliation;

What are we going to offer so you can do an amazing job?

  • Sustainable work pace: 40 hours a week of an accelerated but not frenetic rhythm - no marathons or sleepless nights; The focus is on working smarter.
  • The best tools money can buy so you can be productive in your work; (Macbook, Jetbrains licenses, Slack, Github, TravisCI, NewRelic, DataDog, ElasticSearch, Kibana, Tableau amongst others)
  • Deep and fast code reviews for any of your pull requests - You will also do a lot of them :)
  • Constant discussions about our practices and systems, everybody that wants to speak out is always heard and we are always open to new ideas, practices, and tools;
  • You will be free to dedicate part of your time to improve our systems and implement quality features that make us more efficient or less error-prone;
  • Frequent, fair, and transparent performance evaluations - all developers are evaluated with the same system and have access to the same career development opportunities;

EBANX offers:

  • Casual office and flexible dress code;
  • Spanish, English and Portuguese classes;
  • WAVES - Program of goals and results (variable compensation);
  • EBANX Play - Wellness (Gympass, e-Sports, SESC );
  • Semi flexible hours (8 hours a day - Monday to Friday);
  • EBANX Skills: budget for workshops and courses;
  • EBANX Flexible: monthly Day Off from February to November, birthday Day Off and Rest up Month - one month of paid leave every three years of work anniversary.
  • EBANX Family: Daycare assistance, extended leave for caregivers and support program for children and pregnant women;
  • EBANX Health: Health and Dental Insurance, with subsidy for dependents, and medicine subsidy for ebankers;
  • Life Insurance: Life Insurance 100% paid by EBANX
  • Hello ebanker: psychology, finance and legal orientation.
  • Blue Club: Exclusive discount for ebankers in bakeries, restaurants, courses, electronics store and more!

At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.
Job Description

Introduction to GPS (Gilead Patient Solutions)

In some parts of the world, progress feels inevitable. Access is often taken for granted and the next life-saving innovation is always on the horizon. In other parts of the world, access to essential health services is in doubt and treatable diseases affect thousands of lives every day.

Gilead is a bridge to a healthier world. Building on our legacy, we forge connections — between patients and their communities, across borders, between public health, providers and private industry — to create solutions that address critical health inequities in low- and middle-income countries.

Together, we deliver healthcare access and choice to the people and places that need it most.

We have had a pivotal role in the history of providing access to life-saving medicines in low- and middle-income countries with decades of experience in pioneering novel, collaborative approaches. More than 30 years on, we remain steadfast in our commitment to expanding access to healthcare for everyone, everywhere through sustainable solutions that will have an impact for generations to come.

We are committed to broad patient reach through pioneering access programs that touch all parts of the healthcare ecosystem.

We are the largest private funder of non-profit HIV programs in the world and in the U.S.

Gilead is committed to creating a healthier world for everyone.

Today, half the world’s population lacks access to essential basic health services. To change this, we must innovate – by developing new medicines AND by ensuring their impact wherever the unmet need is greatest.

That’s why for decades we have partnered with governments, communities and other stakeholders worldwide to expand access to medicines, help address the root causes of health inequities and end epidemics of HIV, hepatitis and other diseases in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs).

description:

Job Function:

Employment Type: Permanent

Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliverpowerful solutions.

Job Summary

The Manager, Financial Accounting & Reporting plays a crucial role in overseeing the accounting and financial reporting activities in Brazil. This position is fundamental in ensuring integration of our America offices with the global financial reporting system and processes and acts as a key point of contact with the other global finance teams

Key Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Oversee accounting and financial reporting in compliance with relevant accounting standards, ensuring timely execution of accounting close processes and reporting.
  • Manage month-end closings, including voucher preparation, monthly analyses, and the review and preparation of group reporting packages. Ensure intercompany transactions are processed promptly and accurately.
  • Support the preparation of monthly and quarterly consolidated performance reports for stakeholders and contribute to the annual budgeting process.
  • Implement and maintain financial systems, such as Industrial and Financial Systems (IFS), ensuring proper usage and providing training to team members.
  • Coordinate and fulfil audit and statutory reporting requirements, collaborating with the tax team to ensure tax compliance.
  • Deliver accurate and timely financial reports to stakeholders and investors.
  • Review management papers for ad hoc transactions (e.g., dividends, M&A, Financial result) to support decision-making.
  • Provide accounting expertise and guidance for new projects and transactions.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with external auditors, regulatory authorities, and internal stakeholders regarding financial accounting and reporting.
  • Mentor and supervise junior team members, providing on-the-job training and knowledge transfer.
  • Address ad hoc financial matters and perform additional tasks as assigned by the Head of FA&R Americas

Other Responsibilities:

  • Oversee and ensure proper implementation and compliance with IFRS 16 (Leases), including lease accounting entries, disclosures, and periodic assessment.
  • Liaise with other departments to support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities
  • Strengthen internal controls, drive process improvements, and ensure financial systems are operating effectively operating effectively.
  • Monitor developments in accounting regulations; lead the study, analysis, and execution of new and revised accounting standards and assess their impact on the busines

Requirements and Attributes:

  • Analytical and Reporting Expertise : Demonstrated proficiency in financial analysis and reporting, with comprehensive knowledge of relevant regulatory and accounting standards in global oil and gas companies.
  • Technical Proficiency : Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word, with the ability to manage complex datasets and deliver compelling, professional presentations.
  • Communication and Collaboration : Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, enabling effective collaboration with global finance teams and the production of clear, insightful written reports derived from financial data.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset : Strategic and solution-oriented, with a meticulous and systematic approach to addressing complex financial and operational challenges.
  • Adaptability and Teamwork : Proactive, self-motivated, and able to thrive under tight deadlines in a dynamic, international environment. Strong team player with a collaborative and supportive approach.
  • Time Management : Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and priorities.
  • Educational Background : Minimum bachelor’s degree in accounting and postgraduate qualifications. Professional certifications (e.g. CRC) is mandatory.
  • Professional Experience: Experience with a Big 4 firm is advantageous but not mandatory
